text: A dramatic before/after VFX breakdown, one continuous 10-second locked-off shot of a small plain white studio apartment in daylight: a young woman sits on a chair in the middle of the room reading a book, beige carpet, white walls, a window. The camera never moves and the woman keeps reading, turning a page, the whole time. A thin bright lime vertical wipe line, rendered as a flat 2D screen overlay with a small round lime handle, travels horizontally across the frame; everything on the side the line has already passed changes to the next stage, the other side keeps the previous stage, and the room geometry stays perfectly aligned. Stage 1 (0-2s): raw footage, ordinary empty white room. Stage 2 (2-4s, line sweeps left to right): the room becomes untextured matte grey clay: grey clay coral shapes, grey clay whale and fish models floating in the air, flat grey light. Stage 3 (4-7s, line sweeps right to left): final composite, the whole room is now deep underwater: turquoise water fills the space with god rays from the window, vivid coral reef grows over the floor and walls, a huge humpback whale swims slowly past behind her, schools of bright tropical fish swirl around, bubbles rise, her hair floats gently while she keeps reading calmly. 7-9s: the line sweeps quickly back and forth once, flashing between the plain white room and the underwater world to compare them. 9-10s: the line exits, full underwater shot holds. The before and after are extremely different. Photorealistic, cinematic, clean VFX breakdown style.

author: @bmx_ai13
text:
TITLE: LAST DELIVERY BEFORE THE SHUTTER

FORMAT: 15 seconds exactly, 16:9, ultra photorealistic, 24fps, one single unbroken physical camera take from first frame to last. Zero cuts, zero hidden edits, zero transitions, zero teleportation, zero slow motion, zero static moments.

CHARACTER: Mochi, an adult female long-haired miniature dachshund with a very long low body, short muscular legs, glossy chestnut coat soaked dark by rain, floppy ears, bright amber eyes and a white star on her chest. She wears a snug bright yellow waterproof courier vest with a small zipped delivery pouch on her back and a reflective strip along her spine. She runs, she does not ride anything. Every movement is real dog behavior, real canine gait, real weight and traction, no human gestures, no cartoon expressions.

LOCATION: Crowded downtown street during a heavy evening rainstorm. Wet asphalt mirroring neon storefronts, red taxi tail lights, buses, umbrellas, gutters overflowing, wind pushing sheets of rain sideways.

CAMERA: Handheld FPV style gimbal rig flying at dog height, aggressive banking, extreme foreground parallax, rain droplets hitting and streaking across the lens, constant acceleration, shallow depth of field with bokeh from headlights.

0 to 3 seconds: Begin in violent motion. Mochi's front paws slap through a deep puddle as she leans hard around a wet street corner, ears flying back, claws scrabbling for grip on painted lane lines. The camera skims inches off the asphalt beside her paws, rolls up along her long body, and whips around her shoulder as a bus and taxis roar past in a blur of light.

3 to 6 seconds: A taxi door suddenly swings open from the curb. Mochi skids, back legs sliding sideways, then ducks low and threads underneath the opening door with her belly almost touching the water. The camera executes a fast 270 degree orbit around her, scraping past the dripping door edge and a parked car mirror, then snaps back alongside her as she accelerates.

6 to 9 seconds: TWIST ONE. A gust rips the pouch zipper open and the waterproof envelope flips out, spinning into the wind above the bike lane. Mochi stops for a split second, eyes locking on it, then launches into a full sprint after it as loose cardboard sheets tumble across the lane. She hops over a broken drainage grate, the camera plunging inches above her racing legs, then swinging upward as a passing bus throws a huge curtain of water across the street.

9 to 12 seconds: TWIST TWO. Mochi bursts through the spray with the envelope now clamped carefully in her mouth, ears soaked flat. A startled pigeon flock explodes off a ledge across her path and she weaves through them low and fast. She scrambles up a low curb ramp toward a small glowing bakery where an elderly shopkeeper in a cardigan is pulling down the metal shutter against the storm. The camera sweeps around her, revealing the warm storefront reflected across the flooded pavement.

12 to 15 seconds: TWIST THREE. Mochi drops into a long belly slide across the wet tiles, her long body skimming like a sled under the descending shutter edge, and pushes the envelope into the shopkeeper's hands just in time. He laughs in surprise, opens it, and pulls out a single small dog biscuit wrapped in paper, the delivery was addressed to her all along. He drops the biscuit, she catches it midair. The camera violently swings around his hands and her face, then rockets backward out into the rain as the shutter slams shut and rainwater explodes off the pavement, leaving the glowing gap of light under the shutter.

PHYSICS AND REALISM: Authentic canine anatomy and gait, real paw slip and recovery on wet surfaces, water shaking off fur, believable rain interaction, natural human reactions from pedestrians stepping aside and pointing. No superhero movement, no impossible jumps, nothing exaggerated. Ordinary reality made unbelievably cinematic.

AUDIO: Diegetic only. Heavy rain drumming on awnings and car roofs, paws slapping puddles, claws scraping asphalt, taxi door thunk, bus engine roar and hiss of the water curtain, pigeon wings flapping, short excited panting and one happy bark, shopkeeper's warm surprised laugh, rattling metal shutter crash. No music, no score.

LAST FRAME: Wide pulled back view of the rain soaked street, the closed bakery shutter glowing with a thin line of warm light beneath it, Mochi's silhouette visible through the gap, rain streaking across the lens. No on screen text, no titles, no captions, no logos, no watermarks, no signage readable in frame.

NEGATIVE: No cuts, no transitions, no slow motion, no freeze frames, no bicycle, no dog walking upright, no human like dog hands, no cartoon look, no distorted legs, no extra limbs, no morphing fur, no floating objects, no text.

author: @Ukiyo_il
text:
前半16秒

Create a 16-second, 16:9 cinematic fantasy anime sequence using the reference images in this order:

1. base character reference image
2. Keyframe A: the girl placing giant steaks on the grill while the red dragon watches beside her
3. Keyframe B: extreme macro of garlic butter being spooned onto the meat

Keep the exact same girl and the exact same red dragon throughout the entire clip.

CHARACTER CONSISTENCY:
- The girl must match the base reference image: short brown hair, horned hood, fluffy fur-trimmed outfit, cheerful fantasy adventurer look, rustic apron for cooking.
- The dragon must match the base reference image: large friendly red dragon, dark horns, golden slit-pupil eyes, cream underjaw, green cheek spikes, playful personality.

VISUAL STYLE:
- hand-painted cinematic anime film look
- warm coastal daylight
- rich food-commercial close-ups
- expressive anime acting
- strong comedic timing
- no text, no subtitles, no logos

SETTING:
A green coastal meadow above the beach, calm sea, rocky islands, a small stone cottage, rustic grill, wooden table, herbs, bread, and outdoor cooking tools.

AUDIO / DIALOGUE:
The girl speaks natural Japanese.
The dragon does not speak words, only expressive growls, snorts, and cute rumbling sounds.
Make all quoted Japanese dialogue clearly audible.
No narration and no subtitles.

TIMELINE:

0–3s
Use Keyframe A as the main visual basis.
The girl happily places thick bone-in steaks on the grill one by one while the dragon leans in curiously beside her.
The dragon’s hungry eyes follow the meat.
GIRL: 「よいしょっ！」
Then with a happy smile:
GIRL: 「今日はごちそうだよ！」
SFX: meat landing on the grill, light sizzling, sea breeze.

3–6s
Transition smoothly into Keyframe B.
Extreme macro food close-up.
A wooden spoon pours rich garlic butter onto the meat.
Show bubbling butter, chopped herbs, cracked pepper, and red chili.
GIRL (off screen, playful):
「ふふっ、おいしくな〜れ♪」
SFX: rich sizzling, butter dripping, appetizing food sounds.

6–9s
Return to the wider cooking situation based on Keyframe A.
The dragon leans in too eagerly toward the grill.
The girl quickly raises one finger toward the dragon and stops it.
She gives a cute but firm warning.
GIRL: 「まだだよ！」
DRAGON: small disappointed snort.
Use exaggerated anime timing and clear facial acting.

9–12s
The dragon pulls back, puffs up slightly, and looks like it is trying to help.
The girl notices too late and starts to panic.
GIRL: 「え、ちょっ…ちょっと待っ—」
The dragon inhales dramatically.
Camera tension rises.
Use anticipation and a brief comedic hold before the fire.

12–16s
The dragon suddenly blasts a huge burst of orange fire toward the grill.
The flames explode across the frame in an exaggerated comedic fantasy way.
The girl is engulfed in the blast.
GIRL: 「ぎゃあああーっ！！」
SFX: huge fire WHOOSH, explosive burst, exaggerated scream.
End the clip at the peak of the fire blast as a strong comedic cliffhanger.

IMPORTANT:
- Use only the given reference images as the visual base.
- Preserve character consistency.
- Preserve the same location and cooking setup.
- Strong anime-style motion and facial acting.
- Do not add extra characters.
- No subtitles or on-screen text.

title_zh: 雨夜末班渡轮上的告白
author: @minchoi
text:
"A cinematic, aching love scene on the last ferry of the night, crossing a dark sea in the rain. [Jules], the red-haired woman in the rust-orange wool coat with a single gold hexagon earring in her left ear, and [Harry]
, the clean-cut man in his late 20s with neat side-parted light-brown hair and an olive work jacket, sit side by side on a bench seat by a rain-streaked window in the quiet ferry café. Harbour lights shrink into the dark behind the glass. Intimate romantic drama, six shots. 0s–5s: Wide two-shot from across the empty café. Jules watches the harbour lights recede; Harry watches only her. [Jules: warm quick Glaswegian voice, quiet and wistful]: "This is the last ferry, you know." A beat. [Harry: slow Central Texas drawl, soft and low]: "I know." 5s–10s: Close-up on Jules in profile against the window, rain shadows sliding down her face. She keeps her eyes on the lights and forces a small smile that doesn't reach her eyes. [Jules, trying to sound light]: "Tomorrow you're on a plane, and I'm back to talking to the gulls." 10s–14s: Close-up on Harry. He turns fully toward her, earnest, his voice barely above the engine hum, and his hand finds hers on the bench. [Harry, tender, hopeful]: "Then come with me." 14s–19s: Close-up on Jules. Her composure cracks; her eyes fill, a small broken laugh escapes, and she shakes her head without looking at him. [Jules, voice trembling]: "Don't. Don't make it sound easy." 19s–25s: Tight two-shot. He lifts her hand and holds it against his chest; she finally turns to meet his eyes. [Harry, hoarse, full of feeling]: "Nothing about you's been easy, darlin'. That's why I keep coming back." 25s–30s: Extreme close-up of the two of them, foreheads touching, eyes closed, the harbour lights a soft blur behind them. [Jules, a whisper]: "Then keep coming back." [Harry, a whisper, smiling through it]: "Every time. Every single time." The ferry horn sounds low in the distance.Warm tungsten café lamps against cold blue storm light from the window, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, glistening eyes, subtle film grain. Sound: rain on glass, the engine hum, the creak of the hull, a soft piano note under the final line."

author: @misakin883
text:
15秒、16:9、実写フォトリアル。日本の日常空間を移動しながら戦う、本格的な高速格闘映画。真剣な格闘の間に「高速キッス」が必殺技として繰り返される。

【人物参照】
[画像1]＝主人公の20代前半の成人日本人女性。
[画像2]＝対戦相手の成人男性。
各画像を、それぞれの人物の外見の基準にする。顔立ち、髪型、髪色、年齢感、肌の質感、体格、身体比率、雰囲気を忠実に維持。画像から分かる身長差と体格差、各自の衣装を全カットで統一。女性と男性の役割・特徴を混ぜない。美化、別人化、体格変更、分身、顔の融合、余分な手足を避ける。参照画像の背景とポーズは引き継がない。

女性は普段は普通の若い女性に見えるが、戦闘開始と同時に超高速能力を発揮する。2人とも終始真剣。男性はキッス直後に短く驚愕と困惑を見せ、すぐ本気の反撃へ戻る。

【場所・空間】
生成ごとに、商店街、住宅街の路地、ショッピングモール、スーパー、コンビニ前、駅前広場、地下街、飲食店、ホームセンター、観光地の参道から1か所を選ぶ。15秒を通して同じ連続空間を維持する。
2人は攻防によって前進、後退、横移動、回り込みを続け、開始地点から数メートル移動する。男性も踏み込み、押し返し、追い、かわしながら動く。背景の柱、棚、店先などの位置関係を保ち、移動に応じて別の部分が見える。背景人物は必要に応じて配置し、驚いて振り返り、脇へ下がって進路を開ける。

【動作の基本】
急加速→短いモーションブラーと残像→一瞬鮮明に実体化→格闘技またはキッス→即高速離脱→別方向から再接近、を反復する。
格闘動作は0.2〜0.4秒程度で切り替える。生成ごとに前蹴り、回し蹴り、ローキック、足払い、膝、掌底、肘、中国拳法の連続掌打、八極拳の短距離突進、太極拳の受け流し、柔道の崩し・足技、高速フェイントを複数組み合わせる。同じ技の連打を避け、男性の防御と反撃をつなぐ。攻撃方向と接触、回避の結果を読み取れるようにする。
残像は移動方向に沿う短い軌跡だけ。女性は常に1人。移動中はブラー、技や接触の瞬間は顔と身体を鮮明にする。

【高速キッス：合計6回】
途中5回＋最後1回を必ず描く。
毎回「高速格闘のミディアム〜ワイド→顔2つの超接近アップ→唇の短い接触→即離脱→ミディアム〜ワイドで格闘復帰」。
横顔または斜め横から、唇の接触点が見える角度で撮る。接触の瞬間だけ動作とブラーが止まり、時間が止まったように鮮明になる。途中は各0.3秒、最後は0.5秒。直前まで高速、直後は即再加速。見つめ合い、恋愛の余韻、照れ、笑い、色気の強調を入れず、真剣な接触技として扱う。

【タイムライン】
0〜1.5秒：ミディアム〜ワイド。至近距離で本気の構え。女性は男性を鋭く見据える。カメラがじわりと寄る。
1.5〜2.1秒：男性が先に攻撃。女性が急加速で攻撃線をかわし、顔の目前へ。2人が横へ移動し、カメラが少し遅れて追う。
2.1〜2.4秒：キッス1。超接近アップ、急停止、明確な唇の接触。
2.4〜3秒：ワイドへ戻り、女性が即離脱。男性が振り向いて追い、戦闘位置がずれる。
3〜3.3秒：キッス2。別方向から正面へ接近、超接近アップ、接触、即離脱。
3.3〜4.5秒：蹴り、掌打、足払いなどの高速連撃。男性も防御と反撃。2人が移動し、カメラが斜めに並走。
4.5〜4.8秒：キッス3。超接近アップ、接触時だけ鮮明に停止、即離脱。
4.8〜5.4秒：男性の反撃を側面へかわし、女性が別の技を差し込む。男性も踏み替えて移動。
5.4〜5.7秒：キッス4。超接近アップ、短い接触、即離脱。
5.7〜8.4秒：高速格闘の密度を最大化。0.2〜0.4秒単位で方向と技を変える。打撃、受け流し、崩し、足技を連結。男性も反撃。通路やフロアを移動し、カメラが後退・横移動・回り込みで追う。
8.4〜8.7秒：キッス5。正面へ急停止、超接近アップで接触、即離脱。
8.7〜10.5秒：男性の大きな反撃を紙一重でかわし、異なる技で高速格闘。押し引きしながら移動し続ける。
10.5〜12.5秒：一度だけ距離が開く。互いを見据えて構え直す。呼吸と足運びを保ち、短い緊張の間。背景から開始地点との違いが分かる。カメラが小さく回り込む。
12.5〜13.4秒：女性が猛烈に突進。迎撃をかわして顔の目前で急停止。カメラも踏み込む。
13.4〜13.9秒：最後のキッス6。超接近アップ。最も明確な接触。瞬間だけ速度感が止まる。
13.9〜15秒：ワイドへ。接触直後の衝撃で男性が後方へ弾かれ、転倒または床を滑る。場所に合う決着を選ぶ。女性は静かに男性を見る。カメラが短く追って止まる。

【撮影・質感】
複数カットの実写映画。基本はミディアム〜ワイドで2人の位置と動線を明確にし、キッスだけ超接近アップ。カメラは前後左右の追従、並走、肩越し、小さな回り込み、短いパンを組み合わせる。各カットで背景、視線、移動方向をつなぐ。16:9の横方向を活用。固定撮影や無意味な高速回転を避ける。
35mm映画フィルム調。微細なグレイン、わずかなハレーション、柔らかなハイライト、深い黒、自然で落ち着いた色、控えめなフレアとボケ。過剰なHDRやデジタルの鋭さを避ける。

【音】
環境音、足音、衣擦れ、呼吸、打撃音、短い風切り音を同期。キッスの音は控えめ。BGM、セリフ、笑い声、コミカルな効果音なし。文字、字幕、ロゴ、HUD、ハート演出、勝利ポーズなし。

author: @minchoi
text: Raw vertical 9:16 video recorded on a phone's front camera, one continuous 30-second take with no cuts. It looks like an ordinary unedited phone clip, not a film: slightly soft image, digital noise and compression, flat grey daylight through rain-streaked windows, no colour grading. the picture wobbles whenever she moves and jolts when she pulls the door shut. Sadie, a young woman in her early 20s with long honey-blonde hair in a messy bun with loose strands, no makeup, small gold hoop earrings and an oversized sage-green hoodie with no print, sits in the driver's seat of a small, slightly messy hatchback parked in a supermarket car park on a rainy afternoon. Rain streaks every window; through the rear window, blurred parked cars and a trolley bay. At the start she drops into the seat and pulls the door shut. She tells the story with her hands. Around 18 s she covers her face with both hands. Around 26 s a trolley rattles past her window and she slides down low in the seat as if hiding, laughing. [Sadie: casual young woman's voice, a bit breathless and mortified, recorded on the phone's built-in mic in a small car]: "Okay. I need to tell someone this immediately. ... So I'm in the cereal aisle, and this guy waves at me. Like, a big wave. So I wave back. Big wave. ... He was waving at his wife. Who was right behind me. ... And then I saw them again at the checkout. ... I'm never going back in there. I live in the car now. This is my home." Audio as captured by the phone mic inside a closed car, not studio clean: rain drumming on the roof and windscreen, her voice close and boxy in the small space, the door's heavy thud, fabric rustling against the seat, and outside, muffled through the glass, a trolley rattling past, a car door slamming and an engine starting. No subtitles, no captions, no on-screen text.

author: leonel22
text: Extreme close-up headshot of an ethereal frost woman with flowing white hair and enormous crystal-blue eyes, surrounded by faint luminous sprites. 0–3 seconds: the camera begins a slow, dramatic push toward her dominant eye as delicate snowflakes drift across multiple depths; a cold wind lifts individual strands of white hair and sends sparkling frost past her face. 3–6 seconds: the wind intensifies, snow spirals into a controlled vortex, and her pupils gradually dilate while the intricate blue irises brighten from within. The sprites flicker and circle her like tiny cyan spirits. 6–8 seconds: vivid blue flames ignite around the outer edges of the composition, curling upward and casting animated sapphire light across her skin, lashes, and hair without burning them. 8–10 seconds: her pupils reach full dilation, the eyes flare with brilliant icy-blue energy, the flames surge, and the snow bursts outward in a dramatic shockwave before settling into suspended crystalline particles. Cinematic cold-blue lighting, stark contrast, shallow depth of field, macro facial detail, fluid wind physics, realistic snow, volumetric blue fire, subtle breathing and micro-expressions, stable facial anatomy, smooth continuous motion, no cuts, no distortion, no extra eyes, no facial warping.

author: @minchoi
text: A 30-second, seven-shot ski film edit of Kai <Character reference> skiing one steep, untracked mountain face at golden hour, cut together from several real cameras: a drone, a helmet-mounted action camera, an action camera on a pole, a camera planted in the snow, a chase skier and a long lens across the valley. Photoreal action-sports look, real speed, hard cuts on the action, no slow motion. Kai: athletic man in his 20s, red insulated ski jacket, black ski pants, black gloves, white helmet, mirrored orange goggles, black poles, twin-tip skis. Same outfit and gear in every shot, exactly as in the character sheet. Same mountain face, same powder, and the low sun always on his left as he skis down, throwing long blue shadows across the snow. Shot 1 (0-4s), drone: high aerial view of a sunlit ridge and the whole golden face below it. Kai, small in frame, drops in off the ridge and carves his first big turn, a plume of powder behind him. The drone pushes forward and tilts down to follow. Hard cut. Shot 2 (4-8s), helmet cam: first-person view from an action camera on his helmet, ultra-wide with curved edges. His ski tips and pole baskets at the bottom of the frame, snow rushing underneath, the horizon tilting hard left and right with each carve, powder spraying across the lens. Hard cut. Shot 3 (8-12s), pole cam: an action camera on a short pole held out in his left hand, ultra-wide, pointing back at him. His goggles and helmet fill one side of the frame, his body leaning into a turn, the mountain and sky swinging behind him, snow flecks stuck to the lens. He lets out a wordless shout into the wind. Hard cut. Shot 4 (12-17s), planted cam: a camera set low in the snow just below a wind-lip, pointing up at the sky. Kai launches off the lip and flies straight over the lens, skis crossing the low sun, snow raining down onto the camera, then he lands out of frame behind it. Hard cut. Shot 5 (17-21s), chase skier: a camera on a handheld stabiliser, skiing a few metres behind him at the same speed. He drops into a tuck and straight-lines the fall line, spray from his tails hitting the lens, the slope streaking past. Hard cut. Shot 6 (21-25s), long lens: a telephoto shot from across the valley, slightly shaky, compressing the slope. Kai lays a huge carve and throws a wall of powder backlit gold by the sun. Hard cut. Shot 7 (25-30s), low static camera at the bottom of the run: he skis straight at the lens and skids a hard hockey stop right in front of it, a sheet of snow blasting the camera. As it clears, he pushes his goggles up onto his helmet, breathing hard and laughing. Look: every action-camera shot ultra-wide and crisp with curved edges, small lens flares and snow on the lens; the drone and long-lens shots clean and natural. Warm low sun, long blue shadows, glittering ice crystals in the spray, natural colour, real motion blur. Sound, in stereo, loud and up front like real action-camera audio, never quiet: constant wind roaring and buffeting the camera mics, gusting harder as he picks up speed; the crunch of snow under his skis as he drops in; friends whooping and yelling "Go!" from the ridge at the start; the hiss, scrape and chatter of his edges biting the snow on every carve; poles planting with a crisp crunch; powder spraying off his tails with a soft roar; his hard breathing, and a grunt on the landing; a loud whoosh and the clack of skis as he flies over the planted camera, then the thud of the landing; distant ravens calling across the valley; the ripping sheet of snow blasting the lens on the hockey stop, then his panting laugh and his friends cheering from up the slope. A driving instrumental track with punchy drums sits low underneath, cut on the beat, never covering the natural sound. No subtitles.

author: @tanabe_fragm
text:
A vertical 9:16 Japanese short drama scene, cinematic and photorealistic, shot at night on a riverside walking path in early winter. Streetlights stand at even intervals along the path, their warm light reflected on the dark river. Cool night air, breath faintly visible. Shallow depth of field, soft bokeh from the streetlights, muted teal-and-amber color grade, subtle film grain.

Haruka: Japanese woman, 24, shoulder-length black hair, long beige coat. Quiet voice, but firm.
Souta: Japanese man, 25, short black hair, navy duffle coat. Usually gentle; now shaken.

Four shots, in this order. Exactly four lines of dialogue in natural Tokyo-standard Japanese, spoken softly and slowly, with real pauses. No other lines.

Shot 1 (0–4s) — Frontal tracking shot, the camera moving backward ahead of them, bust shot of both. Haruka and Souta walk side by side toward the camera, a small gap between their shoulders. Haruka keeps looking straight ahead and says quietly:「ねえ…来月から、大阪なんだ」

Shot 2 (4–7s) — Tracking from behind at waist height, focus on the space between their two hands. Their hands swing as they walk, almost touching but never touching. Souta's voice, after a pause, low:「…なんで、今言うの」

Shot 3 (7–11s) — Side tracking shot, moving alongside them. Haruka stops walking. The camera keeps moving with Souta for two more steps, then stops. Focus racks from Souta in the foreground to Haruka standing behind, now one streetlight's distance away. Haruka, still and steady:「言ったら…止められると思ったから」

Shot 4 (11–15s) — Souta turns back toward her. Slow push-in on his face; streetlight falls across only half of it. He starts to speak, swallows it, then says in a hoarse voice:「…止めたら、いてくれんの？」 Hold on his face to the end.

Audio is only their voices, footsteps, the river, and distant traffic — no background music. No subtitles, no on-screen text. Same two people, same clothes, same night riverside path in every shot.

Sadie, a young woman in her early 20s with long honey-blonde waves blowing across her face in the wind, light natural makeup, small gold hoop earrings and an oversized white knit sweater with no print, sits on cool sand on a wide, quiet beach at sunset, knees pulled up. Behind her: low waves rolling in and spreading foam up the sand, the sun sinking toward the horizon, a couple walking a dog along the waterline in the distance, a few gulls. Around 8 s she tucks her hair behind her ear and the wind blows it straight back. Around 16 s a bigger wave runs further up the sand behind her and she glances back at it. Around 24 s she turns her face into the sun for a moment, eyes closed, then smiles back at the camera. text:

author: morg2625275
text:
SUBJECT
A young man with a short green crocodilian snout, scaled jaw, and bright green eyes, wearing a tan button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, leans over a low wire fence in a backyard enclosure. He holds a small grey ceramic bowl filled with pale feed pellets. In the mulched pen beside a shallow stone-rimmed pond, two box turtles with dark, high-domed patterned shells wait.

ACTION
First he lowers the bowl onto the raked mulch and lets it sit. Then one box turtle lifts its head toward the feed and the other steps to the pond's edge. Finally he straightens, rests his hands on the fence rail, and watches the turtles with a calm, neutral expression.

SETTING
A fenced backyard habitat bordered by a wooden post fence and wire mesh, with two tall ornamental grasses at the corners. A small pond with lily pads and visible river stones sits in the foreground. Behind the fence, a green clapboard house with a white-railed porch and warm interior lights; a shaded wooden pavilion with string lights sits deeper in the yard. The mulch is freshly raked into neat lines.

COMPOSITION
A static wide shot from a low angle, the pond and turtles in the foreground, the boy at the fence in the mid-ground, the house and pavilion receding into soft focus. The frame never moves — no push in, no handheld, no zoom, no dolly.

LIGHTING AND STYLE
Warm low afternoon sun rakes through the trees, casting long soft shadows and a gentle back-lift on the scaled snout. Photorealistic, high-definition, with a subtle film grain and a candid documentary feel.

AUDIO
A soft outdoor room tone of rustling grass and distant birds as a continuous bed. Then the dull thud of the ceramic bowl setting on the mulch. Then a soft ripple as the turtle steps into the pond. No music, no dialogue.

title_zh: 圣诞恐龙服装浪漫喜剧
author: @bmx_ai13
text:
SCENE CONTEXT
30 second widescreen 1990s Christmas romcom comedy. Christmas Eve daytime, a cream and gold mansion foyer. A gorgeous woman in an inflatable dinosaur costume opens the door for her boyfriend and finds his gorgeous parents in equally absurd costumes. The boyfriend arrives last in a tuxedo. He gave everyone a different dress code.

ACTIVE REFERENCES
CLAIRE: mid 20s, strikingly beautiful supermodel face, glossy brunette blowout, glam makeup with red lips, wearing a full body green inflatable T-rex costume with tiny arms and a Santa hat on the dinosaur head, her face visible through the open neck. Bright voice.
MARGARET: 50s, stunning 90s supermodel glamour, sculpted cheekbones, voluminous blonde blowout, wearing a full body green Christmas tree costume covered in blinking multicolor bulbs and baubles, a gold star on her head. Silky voice.
HAROLD: 50s, chiseled silver fox, sharp jaw, styled silver hair, wearing a full body red lobster costume with giant padded claws and a black satin bow tie at the neck. Deep dry voice.
JAKE: late 20s, handsome, swept back blond 90s hair, sharp black tuxedo, holding red roses. Cheerful voice.

LOCATION MAP
Foreground: marble floor.
Midground: tall white double doors with a wreath, garland pillars with warm fairy lights, poinsettias, lit candles.
Background through the doors: snowy courtyard, snow falling at 3 km/h.

FORMAT MODE
Timed multishot, cuts only at the specified points, the camera does not cut on its own.

OPTICS
Each segment holds its stated FOV, no drift mid-segment. Soft vintage prime look, creamy fairy light bokeh.

CAMERA
Eye level operator inside the foyer facing the doors, locked off comic framing, quick reaction cuts.

ACTION
0.0s to 3.0s, WS 63 degrees: Claire waddles toward the doors in the swaying T-rex costume, practicing a roar with her tiny arms up. Doorbell chimes.
3.0s HARD CUT

3.0s to 5.0s, MS 47 degrees from behind Claire: she flings the doors open and shouts "RAWR! Merry Christmas, baby!"
5.0s HARD CUT

5.0s to 8.0s, WS 47 degrees reverse: Margaret the Christmas tree and Harold the lobster stand side by side on the snowy step, perfectly calm, bulbs blinking.
8.0s HARD CUT

8.0s to 10.0s, CU 29 degrees: Claire's smile freezes, her tiny T-rex arms stuck mid wave.
10.0s HARD CUT

10.0s to 13.0s, MCU 29 degrees: Margaret smiles elegantly, says "You must be Claire." Claire off screen: "And you must be a tree."
13.0s HARD CUT

13.0s to 16.0s, MS 47 degrees: Harold extends a giant lobster claw for a handshake. Claire strains her tiny T-rex arms forward. They fall short by a hand's width. Both keep straining in silence.
16.0s HARD CUT

16.0s to 19.0s, MCU 29 degrees: Harold taps his bow tie with his claw, says "Jake said black tie." Margaret: "He told me costume party." Claire: "He told me dress fun."
19.0s HARD CUT

19.0s to 22.0s, WS 63 degrees: Jake steps up behind his parents in the sharp tuxedo with roses, stops dead, says "Why is everyone dressed like that? I said formal dinner."
22.0s HARD CUT

22.0s to 25.0s, MS 47 degrees from behind Jake: the dinosaur, the tree and the lobster turn their heads toward him in perfect unison. All of Margaret's bulbs switch to solid red.
25.0s HARD CUT

25.0s to 27.0s, CU 29 degrees: Claire stares at Jake, says flatly "Rawr." Her costume slowly deflates with a long wheeze around her.
27.0s HARD CUT

27.0s to 30.0s, WS 63 degrees: Harold pinches Jake's ear with his lobster claw and drags him inside past Claire. Jake yelps "Ow ow ow!" Margaret follows, bulbs blinking happily again.

PERFORMANCE
Comedy through total seriousness: the parents treat their costumes as completely normal. Glamorous faces stay perfectly composed while the costumes are ridiculous. Claire's eyes widen in small steps, lips pressed together. Real skin texture, wet catch lights.

PHYSICS
Inflatable costume sways and bounces with each step and sags softly when deflating. Lobster claws are heavy and padded. Snowflakes land and melt on hair and costumes.

LIGHTING
Warm 3200K tungsten interior from lamps, candles and fairy lights. Cool 5600K snow daylight through the doors as rim light. Margaret's costume bulbs cast colored light on nearby faces.

AUDIO
Diegetic only: doorbell chime, costume fan motor hum, plastic squeak, wind and snow hiss at the open door, bulbs clicking, deflating wheeze, spoken dialogue. No music.

STYLE
Photoreal 1990s holiday romcom on 35mm film, fine grain, soft halation.

OUTPUT SETTINGS
16:9 widescreen, real time, 24fps.

POSITIVE LOCKS
Same four people, same costumes and same foyer in every cut. Faces stay beautiful and fully visible. Clean frames with no on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermarks.

Handheld camera races backward directly in front of her as she runs toward camera, repeatedly looking behind her.SMASH CUT to an extreme close-up of the MAIN CHARACTER asleep in bed, sweating and twitching violently during a nightmare.Inside the nightmare, a deep distorted male whisper says:“Three…”A huge blood-red number 3 flashes briefly against black.4–8 seconds: Rapid nightmare fragments: the frightened woman reaches a dead end. A shadowy male figure approaches behind her, but his face is NEVER visible. Extreme close-up of the killer's hand reveals a distinctive ornate silver ring.The whisper returns:“Two…”Blood-red 2.The main character suddenly wakes with a violent gasp.Hard cut to morning television news footage showing the SAME WOMAN'S photograph.Female television reporter:“Police discovered the body early this morning…”The man's face drains of color.8–12 seconds: Police interrogation room. Harsh overhead fluorescent light. The main character sits across from two suspicious detectives.Detective, coldly:“You described the murder before we found the body.”Close-up on the main character.“Because I saw it happen.”Detective:“In a dream?”Silence. Fast close-up of the detective staring at him like he no longer believes a word he says.12–16 seconds: Warm Sunday sunlight streams through stained-glass windows inside a beautiful old church. The man's younger sister walks beside him down the aisle. She gently takes his arm.SISTER:“Maybe coming back here is exactly what you need.”He gives her a conflicted look.A friendly pastor approaches and shakes the sister's hand.CLOSE-UP:The pastor's hand.The silver ring.Everything suddenly goes silent.Extreme close-up of the main character's eyes widening.FLASH CUT back to the nightmare—the killer's hand wearing THE SAME RING.16–20 seconds: Music suddenly becomes a pounding cinematic pulse.Rapid investigative montage:The main character frantically covers his apartment wall with photographs of murdered women, newspaper articles, church bulletins and handwritten notes.He searches through old records late at night.A newspaper headline:SECOND WOMAN FOUND DEADA woman nervously enters a church confession booth.A shadow moves behind the confessional screen.A detective slams a crime-scene photograph onto a table.Police lights explode across the main character's face as he runs through a wet nighttime street.Detective shouting:“STOP!”20–24 seconds: Suddenly—Silence.The main character is asleep again.His nightmare begins.His sister stands completely alone beneath a flickering streetlight.She slowly turns toward him.Terrified.A dark figure appears several yards behind her.His sister whispers:“Michael?”The distorted voice begins:“Three…”FLASH — red 3.His sister running.“Two…”FLASH — red 2.Extreme close-up of Michael screaming awake:“NO!”24–28 seconds: The trailer erupts into extremely fast cinematic cuts synchronized with thunderous impacts:Michael sprinting through pouring rain.His sister pounding desperately against a locked door.Police racing toward the church.Michael smashing through a church doorway.A pastor turning suddenly in a dark hallway.A flashlight sweeping across rows of empty pews.Michael struggling with an unseen person.His sister screaming.The ornate silver ring hitting the floor and spinning across stone.A handgun trembling in Michael's hand. Church bells violently ringing.Michael enters a dark confession booth and sits down.Everything becomes silent.From behind the wooden screen:PRIEST: “What would you like to confess?”Michael stares straight ahead.Calm now.MICHAEL: “I'm going to kill someone tonight.”28–30 seconds: BLACK.A woman's frightened whisper:“One…”A gigantic blood-red 1 flashes onto screen with a violent bass hit.TITLE:3 2 1 — RED LIGHTThe numbers briefly flicker like a countdown. Final extremely fast shot: Michael standing alone inside the dark church as red-and-blue police lights pulse through the stained-glass windows.CUT TO BLACK.TRAILER STYLE: Psychological thriller mixed with supernatural mystery and serial-killer suspense. The dreams should feel surreal and fragmented but the real world must remain grounded and photorealistic. Avoid excessive gore; create fear through shadows, implication, facial expressions, sound, and rapid glimpses. Never clearly reveal the killer's identity during the trailer—the silver ring is the major visual clue. The pastor should initially appear completely trustworthy and ordinary. Michael's emotional progression should move from confusion → fear → obsession → desperation → grim determination. The final confession-booth line should be the trailer's biggest dramatic moment.

text:
Create a 15-second photorealistic live-action video, horizontal 16:9, in one continuous shot. A real ginger house cat is watching a model railway on a wooden table. For the first half, the camera is so low inside the miniature street that the scene looks like a full-sized city with a gigantic cat behind it. The change in camera position reveals the true scale.

CAMERA AND LOOK

DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. Begin at rail height, looking along a gently curving track. Blue-hour light, warm apartment windows, a bright red two-car Japanese commuter train with lit headlights. A little handheld drift, subtle tape grain, believable motion blur. Keep the train, the cat’s eye and the paw large enough to read on a phone.

0–4 seconds. Open with the red train already rounding the bend toward us. In the gap between two buildings, a huge green cat’s eye is watching it. The eye tracks the train as it passes the lens from left to right. A ginger ear twitches above the roofline.

4–8 seconds. The camera pans right with the train. As the last carriage clears the bend, one broad ginger paw comes down into the newly empty space just behind it. A soft tap. The paw misses. The train carries straight on along the same track.

8–12 seconds. In one physical movement, lift the camera above the rooftops and pull back past the front edge of the wooden table. Now we see the entire model railway in a lived-in apartment and the ordinary-sized ginger cat sitting on a chair behind it. The same red train is still moving around the loop.

12–15 seconds. Hold the wider view. The cat draws back the paw it just used and gives it two slow, casual licks. The red train rolls past again in the foreground. Cut on the second lick.

AUDIO

A steady wheel-on-rail rhythm, the soft tap of the paw and quiet room tone. As the camera pulls back, the little electric motor becomes audible. No dialogue, music, captions or logos.

title_zh: 凌晨三点姐妹厨房坦白
author: @sebatheepan
text:
20s, 16:9, 6 cuts, photoreal live-action, native audio with synced dialogue, British English accents. No on-screen text, subtitles, captions, watermarks or logos.

STYLE: intimate chamber drama, 35mm grain, shallow focus, understated performances.

CAST: NORA - woman, 45, auburn hair in a loose knot, black reading glasses pushed up on top of her head, grey cardigan over a faded T-shirt, tired eyes. ELLIE - her younger sister, 32, black curly shoulder-length hair soaked from rain, oversized denim jacket, jeans, silver hoop earrings.

PROPS: two identical mustard mugs. Nora holds one. A second, empty mug stands clearly visible at the empty chair opposite her.

PALETTE: amber pendant lamp vs cold teal under-cabinet light, deep shadows, natural skin.
STORY: At 3 a.m. Ellie comes home to admit she sold their late mother's house. Nora already knows.

BEATS:
0.0-3.5s | CUT 1, wide, static, eye level: heavy rain on the kitchen window. Ellie stands frozen in the doorway on the left, dripping. Nora sits at the table on the right, hands round her mug; the empty mug waits opposite. Stillness.

3.5-7.5s | CUT 2, clean medium close-up on Nora, nothing in the foreground, 50mm, slow push-in. Eyes down. NORA (flat, quiet, exhausted): "You sold it. Mum's house. Without asking me."

7.5-12.0s | CUT 3, close-up on Ellie in the doorway, 85mm, subtle handheld. Her eyes fill with tears; she swallows before speaking. ELLIE (defensive, voice cracking on the last word): "I was drowning, Nora. You weren't answering."

12.0-15.5s | CUT 4, same clean medium close-up on Nora, eyes dry at first. She looks up, pulls the glasses down off her head and sets them on the table. Only then does one tear run down her cheek. She says nothing. Only rain.

15.5-18.0s | CUT 5, low profile shot along the tabletop: Nora's hand slides the empty second mug across the wood to the empty chair. NORA (whisper, barely voiced): "Sit down."

18.0-20.0s | CUT 6, medium close-up on Ellie, already seated at the table, both hands round the second mug. One shaky breath, half laugh, half sob, then stillness. Hold.

AUDIO: dialogue close and dry. Steady rain on glass audible from the first frame, fridge hum, room tone. Mug scrape on wood at 16s. Ellie's half-laugh sob at 18.5s. No music.

NEGATIVE: no text, no extra people, no foreground shoulders in Nora's shots, no repeat of the CUT 1 wide, no props appearing or vanishing, no melodramatic sobbing, no face morphing, no lip-sync drift.

title_en: Lucy Walks Home After Diner Shift
author: @EndFolding79421
text: Lucy stepped out of the small diner where she worked, the doorbell jingling softly behind her. The night air was cool and crisp, a welcome change from the stuffy warmth inside. She took a deep breath, feeling the slight chill of the evening settle on her skin. The street was quiet, only the distant hum of traffic breaking the silence. Her shift had been long and exhausting, filled with the clatter of dishes and the constant chatter of customers. Now, the quiet seemed almost surreal, a stark contrast to the noise and chaos she had just left behind. Lucy adjusted her bag on her shoulder, glancing around as she began her walk home. The dim streetlights cast long shadows across the pavement, their flickering bulbs adding an eerie quality to the otherwise peaceful night. Lucy's footsteps echoed softly, a rhythmic accompaniment to her thoughts. She felt a strange mix of relief and unease; relief that her shift was over, and unease that she had to walk home alone at this hour. She tried to shake off the feeling, telling herself it was just her imagination. But as she walked, the sensation of being watched grew stronger. Lucy's eyes darted to the darkened alleyways and the shadowy corners of the street, half-expecting to see someone lurking there. Each time, there was nothing but the oppressive darkness. Her thoughts wandered to the events of the day, the usual frustrations of work blending with snippets of conversations she'd had with her coworkers. She thought of Megan, her closest friend at the diner, and their plans to go out together on the weekend. The thought brought a small smile to her lips, momentarily easing her tension. But the feeling of being watched persisted. Lucy quickened her pace, her heartbeat matching the rapid rhythm of her footsteps. She turned down a quieter street, the buildings looming tall and silent on either side. The oppressive silence pressed in on her, amplifying every sound, every rustle of leaves, every distant car horn. A sudden noise behind her made Lucy stop in her tracks. She spun around, eyes wide, searching the shadows for the source. The street was empty, the only movement the gentle sway of a tree branch in the breeze. She stood there for a moment, heart pounding, before forcing herself to turn back and keep walking. "It's just your imagination," she muttered under her breath, trying to steady her nerves. But the cold knot of fear in her stomach told her otherwise.

High-angle descending camera. She drops from the ledge, executes a compact aerial rotation, and lands in a controlled dive roll. Dust and grit scatter as she rises into a sprint through a ruined alley.

[CUT 12 | .60–00:21.40]
Fast front three-quarter tracking shot. Jane speed-vaults a broken concrete barrier, transitions into an aerial cartwheel over scattered debris, and lands running toward an industrial rooftop.
[CUT 13 | .40–00:23.20]
Drone shot descending from behind. Jane traverses a narrow rusted rail with controlled balance, jumps to a lower platform, and performs a corkscrew-style aerial rotation over a clear landing zone.
[CUT 14 | .20–00:25.00]
Low-angle tracking shot. Jane sprints up a sloped concrete slab, plants one foot against a sturdy wall, rebounds into a backflip, and lands on a broad platform. A collapsed highway gap appears ahead.

[CUT 15 | .00–00:27.50]
Climactic side-follow shot transitioning into a controlled camera orbit. Jane takes three powerful strides and launches across the major rooftop gap, executing a high corkscrew aerial. Brief selective speed ramp at the apex. She lands firmly on the opposite rooftop; dust and loose gravel burst outward from the impact.
[CUT 16 | .50–00:30.00]
Low front tracking shot transitions into a wide rear view. Jane converts her landing into a sprint, vaults one final piece of rubble, and runs deeper into the ruined city. The camera swings behind her, revealing collapsed highways and skeletal skyscrapers. End with Jane still running at full speed.
[CHOREOGRAPHY & PHYSICAL VFX]
Chain every movement through momentum: takeoff, flight, contact, recoil, landing, recovery, acceleration. Use realistic center-of-gravity shifts, planted feet, accurate grips, and believable airborne trajectories.

Dust, grit, gravel, rust flakes, falling masonry, vibrating rails, and flexing sheet metal must originate from actual contact or disturbed structures. Environmental damage accumulates and never resets between shots. Debris follows gravity. Preserve realistic physical weight.
Dynamic tracking, low-angle follow shots, aerial camera movement, strong parallax, natural motion blur at high speed, and subtle impact camera shake. Keep stunt movements readable and maintain consistent spatial direction.
Audio: diegetic ambience only—wind through ruins, boots on concrete, gravel impacts, metal rattles, fabric movement, and distant structural creaks. No background music.

[STRICT NEGATIVES]
No character identity or outfit changes. No hairstyle changes, face distortion, duplicate bodies, extra limbs, clipping, warped anatomy, teleportation, levitation, impossible mid-air direction changes, weightless landings, or unexplained destruction. No magic aura, energy beams, shockwave rings, spatial rifts, or artificial afterimage duplicates. No passing through solid objects or electrical wires. No anime, video-game rendering, or obvious CGI.
Final result: A relentless, physically grounded 30-second wasteland parkour showcase with escalating acrobatics, environmental cause-and-effect, cinematic camera choreography, and a spectacular rooftop-gap finale.

author: @tirtaVEX
text:
【视觉风格】
超写实电影级真人质感，恢宏的元素特效；一次连续生成。夜晚的城市屋顶，高对比度，轮廓光，雨滴在短暂慢动作中飞溅。镜头运动富有戏剧张力且控制精准；氛围从紧张推进至爆发，最终归于充满敬意的寂静：两位势均力敌的战士以平局收场。
【角色与场景】
女战士：体态矫健优雅，目光锐利，绿色双眸。身体上分布着发出蓝光的纹路，戴黑色皮手套；手持一对缠绕蓝色闪电的短匕首。
男战士：肌肉极其发达，留短胡须，右臂有部落图腾纹身。穿工装裤；双前臂佩戴炽热的金属护臂，双拳燃烧着火焰。
场景：宽阔湿润的混凝土屋顶，褪色的直升机停机坪标线、通风管道，背景是灯火通明的城市楼群。所有镜头中的面部特征、服装、伤痕和装备均保持一致；爆炸后的混凝土裂缝持续保留。
【分镜列表】
镜头1｜00:00–00:05 — 全景，摇臂镜头穿过雨幕下降，移向停机坪；两人相向而立，武器与双拳上的能量缓缓亮起。音效：雷鸣、瓢泼大雨。
镜头2｜00:05–00:10 — 中远景，以快速而精准的环绕镜头跟随一组连贯交锋：两人疾冲靠近，匕首格挡戴有护臂的重拳，电火花与烈焰迸射。音效：金属撞击声、能量爆鸣。
镜头3｜00:10–00:15 — 横向跟拍地面攻击与闪避：男战士猛击混凝土地面，火焰冲击波贴地横扫；女战士翻腾跃过火浪，落地后面向男战士。翻腾时短暂变速进入慢动作，雨滴仿佛悬停空中，随后恢复正常速度。音效：沉重轰击声，声音短暂压低，随后响起蒸汽嘶鸣。
镜头4｜00:15–00:20 — 镜头富有戏剧性地向前推进，捕捉最终碰撞：两人同时向前冲，火焰重拳与雷电匕首在中央相撞，形成白光穹顶，混凝土地面出现环形裂缝；反冲力将两人震倒，彼此相对跪地。音效：震耳欲聋的爆炸声与低频轰鸣。
镜头5｜00:20–00:25 — 低机位双人中景，随着烟雾散开，摄影机缓缓向前移动；女战士的一把匕首停在男战士颈侧附近，两人的另一只手在下方相互扣锁。音效：雨势渐弱，远处传来雷声。
镜头6｜00:25–00:30 — 固定双人近景，始终保持在轴线同一侧：女战士露出淡淡的微笑。两人同时解除威胁，依然相对跪地，彼此致敬；双方的能量同时熄灭。
【规则】
必须依次呈现：相向对峙、正面交锋、地面攻击与翻腾闪避、最终攻击、平局僵持、彼此放开。没有赢家。

author: @PromptSin
text:
Create a 10-second photorealistic World War I aerial pursuit, horizontal 16:9, using the supplied image as the exact opening frame.

AIRCRAFT AND CONTINUITY
Exactly two single-seat biplane fighters throughout. The burgundy aircraft with black cross markings is the pursuer, nearest the camera. The olive aircraft with roundels is the target, ahead and slightly lower. Preserve their reference designs, colors, markings, wing structures, rigging, open cockpits, pilots and fixed landing gear. They fly in the same direction, with the olive aircraft leading at all times.

0–3 SECONDS — IMMEDIATE ACTION
Continue directly from the reference without a static hold. Both propellers spin rapidly. The olive aircraft banks hard left and descends toward a gap between clouds. The burgundy aircraft immediately banks left in pursuit and fires one short machine-gun burst forward from its nose-mounted guns. Brief muzzle flashes and a few thin, fast tracer streaks pass behind the target without hitting it.

3–7 SECONDS — DIVING PURSUIT
The olive aircraft steepens its descending turn along the edge of a cloud. The burgundy aircraft follows the same curved flight path several aircraft lengths behind, firing one more brief burst before ceasing fire. Wisps of vapor sweep past; the distant fields and river move rapidly across the background. Both aircraft remain identifiable, with clear separation and no complete cloud occlusion.

7–10 SECONDS — LOW SWEEP AND PULL-OUT
Both aircraft emerge below the cloud edge. The olive aircraft smoothly levels its wings and pulls out of the dive; the burgundy aircraft follows a moment later. The camera drops slightly behind and below the pursuer, revealing both planes racing forward over the landscape. End mid-pursuit with both aircraft intact and the olive plane still ahead.

CAMERA
One continuous airborne tracking shot starting at the supplied rear three-quarter viewpoint. The camera follows the burgundy aircraft smoothly while keeping the olive target visible ahead. Subtle airframe-like vibration, strong background parallax, readable silhouettes. No cuts, teleportation, reverse angles or slow motion.

PHYSICS AND LOOK
Real-time motion, convincing weight, aerodynamic banking and smooth pull-out. Aircraft turn through banked flight, never skid sideways, hover or fly backward. Consistent sunlight, photorealistic weathered fabric, wood, metal and taut rigging. Natural propeller motion blur and cinematic cloud depth. No modern jet-like speeds or maneuvers.

AUDIO
Continuous period piston-engine roar, rushing wind and two short synchronized machine-gun bursts from the burgundy pursuer. Engine pitch rises during the dive. No music, dialogue or narration.

AVOID
Extra aircraft, swapped pursuer and target, changing markings, morphing wings, missing rigging, extra propellers, detached wheels, missiles, jets, lasers, fireballs, collisions, crashes, visible injuries, repeated loops, frozen opening, text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

title_zh: 黑白黑色电影警车追缉
author: @PromptSin
text:
15-second horizontal 16:9 photorealistic black-and-white police pursuit, filmed as a tense 1950s crime movie. Use the supplied opening image as the first frame and the supplied ending image as the final composition. Animate a coherent physical chase; do not dissolve or morph between still images.

CONTINUITY: Exactly two early-1950s American sedans: the dark getaway sedan with its distinctive split chrome grille, and the black-and-white police sedan with white doors, star badge and single roof beacon. Preserve both reference designs and drivers. Same empty wet warehouse district at night, period streetlamps and brick buildings.

0–4s — IMMEDIATE ACTION: Begin in the opening composition, already moving fast. The dark sedan rounds the wet corner, throwing water from its tires. The police follows the same turn a few car lengths behind. Low front three-quarter tracking camera retreats ahead of them. Engines roar, a period siren wails, tires squeal. Realistic suspension roll, wheel rotation and forward momentum.

4–8s — OVERTAKE: Cut to a moving side view with both vehicles visible. On the straight, the police accelerates up the getaway car's left side, draws level and clearly overtakes. Show the full passing maneuver with space between the vehicles. Water spray and streetlamp reflections emphasize speed.

8–12s — INTERCEPTION: Once safely ahead at a broad intersection, the police brakes and swings into a tight controlled turn across the escape route. The getaway brakes hard. Show the police turning and the getaway decelerating together in a wide shot. Tire squeal, spray and suspension compression. No collision or teleportation.

12–15s — ENDING: The getaway stops short. Settle into the ending reference's elevated sidewalk three-quarter view: dark sedan at left, angled police sedan at right blocking its route, both intact with a clear gap between them. Hold this composition for the final second as spray settles and engines idle. Drivers remain inside. Headlights and roof beacon remain active.

LOOK: True monochrome, rich blacks, luminous wet-road reflections, hard film-noir lighting, restrained 35mm grain, realistic metal and glass. Fast action at normal speed, decisive cuts and clear spatial continuity.
AUDIO: Engines with natural pitch changes, period siren, tire squeal and water spray. No music, dialogue or narration.
AVOID: Color, sepia, modern objects, extra cars, pedestrians, swapped vehicle identities, disappearing cars, deformed wheels, impossible acceleration, collisions, explosions, gunfire, slow motion, dissolves, text, subtitles and watermarks.

author: @7A7PIcreates
text:
The enormous bull made entirely from dense white storm clouds charges continuously at full speed across the white salt desert. Small electric-blue lightning bolts pulse naturally inside its cloud body. Hard cinematic cuts, same bull, same environment, continuous forward motion. 
SHOT 1: 0–3s
Extreme low frontal 24 mm shot. The cloud bull charges directly toward the camera, enormous horns framing the sky. One front leg rises toward the lens while blue lightning flashes subtly through its chest. 
SHOT 2: 3–6s
Fast side-tracking shot. The camera races parallel to the bull. Powerful natural galloping motion as turbulent clouds roll through its body. Vapor streams backward from its shoulders and legs while thin lightning branches travel from neck to torso. 
SHOT 3: 6–9s
Extreme close-up tracking beside the bull's head. Dense clouds sculpt its eyes, muzzle, and horns. A small lightning pulse travels beneath the cloud surface and briefly illuminates its face from within. Vapor whips across the lens. 
SHOT 4: 9–12s
Top-down aerial tracking shot. The enormous white bull races across the salt flat, leaving a turbulent cloud trail behind it. Tiny blue electrical flashes flicker through the moving cloud mass. 
SHOT 5: 12–15s
Ground-level hoof shot. A gigantic vapor hoof crashes beside the camera and explodes into rolling white clouds across the salt, then reforms instantly as the bull continues charging.
SHOT 6: 15–20s
Extreme low frontal shot. The bull accelerates directly toward the camera. Its cloud body grows increasingly turbulent, lightning rapidly branching through its chest and shoulders. At the final instant, the colossal bull leaps over the camera as white storm clouds engulf the frame. The camera tilts upward to follow it into the cobalt-blue sky. Ultra-photorealistic cinematic fashion film, physically believable volumetric clouds, natural bull locomotion, turbulent vapor dynamics, subtle internal electric-blue lightning, brutal midday sunlight, and monumental scale. No fur, no solid bull, no cartoon clouds, no magical glow, and no giant lightning strikes. Continuous fast motion throughout.

author: @AI__TSUBAKI
text:
30-second horizontal 16:9 1080p first-person gameplay capture in the style of PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS, played in PUBG FPP (first-person perspective) mode during an intense late-game squad match, recorded directly from a PC screen at a smooth high frame rate. Hyper-realistic, photorealistic next-generation graphics rendered in Unreal Engine 5 with Lumen global illumination and Nanite geometry. It is almost indistinguishable from real-life helmet-cam combat footage, but it is clearly a game capture because of the on-screen HUD. Ultra-detailed photogrammetry textures, physically accurate lighting, realistic ambient occlusion and soft shadows, volumetric smoke and dust, real-world material response on every surface, sharp 1080p clarity, no motion blur, no film grain, no cinematic color grading.

Persistent PUBG-style HUD, always visible on screen for the entire 30 seconds, fixed in place, never fading and never changing position:
- Top center: a thin horizontal compass bar with degree ticks.
- Top right: a small counter for players alive and a small kill counter, with a kill feed below them where short white notification lines appear after each kill.
- Bottom center: a thin white health bar, and above it small icons for the equipped helmet and vest. The health bar drops and turns red when the player is hit, and refills when the player heals.
- Bottom right: a square minimap showing the terrain in muted greens and browns, with a small player arrow. Next to it, a white ammo counter showing the rounds in the magazine and the reserve ammo. The magazine count drops with every shot and refills after the reload.
- Center: a small dot crosshair, plus a brief white X hit marker flash on each hit and a red X on each kill.
The HUD is clean, semi-transparent, white and minimal, rendered in sharp UI graphics over the 3D image. HUD text is limited to simple numbers and short abstract lines, with no logos.

PUBG looting system: shortly after an enemy dies, the body is replaced by a PUBG-style wooden loot crate on the ground, a death box made of weathered wooden planks. When the player opens it, the PUBG inventory screen appears as a full-screen overlay over the dimmed, blurred game view. The left column is a vicinity list of nearby items, each shown as a realistic item icon with a short abstract label line. The middle column shows the player's backpack contents. The right side shows equipment slots for the helmet, vest, backpack and two primary weapons. The player drags items from the vicinity list into the backpack and equipment slots, and each item slides across with a quick UI animation. When the inventory closes, the normal HUD view returns immediately.

Camera and view: locked true first-person view at a wide 90-degree gameplay FOV, never third-person and never an over-the-shoulder view. The player's hands wear worn black tactical gloves with frayed fabric, stitching and dust in the creases. They hold a battle-worn AKM assault rifle with a scratched, oil-stained dark walnut stock and handguard showing real wood grain, a weathered black steel receiver with chipped paint and bare metal wear on the edges, and a plain red dot sight with a faint lens reflection. There is no skin and no bright colors, only a realistic military weapon. The rifle sits in the lower right of the frame, slightly left of the minimap. Natural view bob, strong realistic AK recoil kick with muzzle climb, a visible muzzle flash and a brief puff of gun smoke from the barrel, and fast mouse-driven flicks. One continuous unbroken take with no cuts, no camera switches and no replays.

Map: an original PUBG-style battle royale map in the countryside of rural Eastern Europe. An abandoned village of two-story red brick and grey concrete houses with shattered windows, crumbling mortar, peeling plaster and water stains. Broken wooden fences with weathered grain, rusted corrugated sheds and a crumbling compound wall. Burned-out cars and a rusted military truck with flaking paint sit along a cracked, rutted dirt road with puddles and tire tracks. Rolling golden wheat fields with individual stalks swaying in the wind, and pine tree lines on the hills. A derelict military base with a concrete watchtower stands on a distant ridge. The sky is overcast, with soft cold diffused daylight and hazy atmospheric depth. Thick smoke columns rise from burning vehicles in the distance, with dust particles and ash drifting through the air.

Battlefield atmosphere: it feels like a real war zone. Constant distant gunfire echoes across the hills from other fights. Muzzle flashes flicker on the far ridge. A red smoke flare burns in a field in the distance. Dirt and brick debris kick up from incoming fire around the player.

Enemies: photorealistic soldiers in mixed camouflage gear with realistic fabric folds, level-2 and level-3 military helmets and tactical vests with pouches, using cover and moving aggressively. When hit, they react with weight, stagger and ragdoll realistically to the ground.

[00:00–00:03] Crouched behind the crumbling compound wall, the player pops up, flicks onto an enemy running across the dirt road and drops him with a short controlled AK burst. Hit markers flash, the enemy screams as he falls, and a kill notification appears in the kill feed.
[00:03–00:06] Incoming bullets snap past and chip the bricks beside the player's head, throwing dust and brick fragments across the view. One round hits the player: the screen edges flash red, the view jolts, and the health bar drops to about half. The player ducks and sprints through a broken doorway into a ruined brick house.
[00:06–00:09] Inside the dim house, with light beams through the broken windows and dust floating in them, the player swings around a doorframe and taps an enemy on the staircase with two shots. The enemy tumbles down the stairs. Another kill notification appears.
[00:09–00:11] At a shattered window, the player does a fast tactical reload. The curved AK magazine is ripped out and a fresh one slams in, followed by a hard charging-handle pull, and the ammo counter refills. An enemy shouts orders somewhere outside.
[00:11–00:13] The player vaults out through the window into the wheat field and throws a smoke grenade toward the rusted military truck. It pops and thick, volumetric white smoke rolls across the road.
[00:13–00:16] Two enemies rush out of the smoke, yelling. The player holds the AK steady and sprays through them. Bullets spark off the truck's steel body and kick up dirt clods, while the ammo counter drains fast. Both enemies collapse into the wheat, and two kill notifications stack in the kill feed. Their bodies are replaced by wooden loot crates lying in the flattened wheat.
[00:16–00:18] The player jogs to the nearest loot crate, crouches over it and looks down at its weathered wooden planks. The PUBG inventory screen opens over the dimmed game view.
[00:18–00:23] Looting in the inventory screen: the vicinity list shows a first aid kit, bandages, an energy drink, painkillers, boxes of rifle ammo, a level-3 military helmet and a bolt-action sniper rifle with a long-range scope. The player quickly drags the first aid kit, bandages, energy drink and painkillers into the backpack, drags the ammo boxes in, swaps in the level-3 helmet, which replaces the old helmet in the equipment slot, and drags the bolt-action sniper rifle into the second weapon slot. The inventory screen closes and the normal HUD returns, with the new helmet icon visible.
[00:23–00:27] Still crouched in the tall wheat, the player uses the first aid kit. The AK is lowered out of view, and the gloved hands appear, unrolling and wrapping a white medical bandage. A circular progress ring fills around the crosshair with a small countdown number. The health bar smoothly refills to almost full. Then the player drinks the energy drink, tilting the can toward the camera, and a small boost bar appears just above the health bar.
[00:27–00:30] Fully healed, the player raises the AK again, rises from the wheat and scans the smoky road and the distant ridge. Gunfire still echoes from far-off fights, the smoke drifts past, and the player turns toward the military base on the ridge as the clip ends. The HUD stays on screen.

Style: authentic, intense PUBG FPP gameplay with hyper-realistic next-gen visuals, like a raw live stream clip from a skilled player in a chaotic endgame. Readable action, confident crosshair placement, muted desaturated military color palette with earthy browns, greys and olive greens, and extreme detail. The persistent HUD and the PUBG inventory screen are the only on-screen graphics. No real-world text, no brand logos, no PUBG logo, no watermark, no streamer overlay, no webcam frame.

Audio: realistic, aggressive battlefield sound design. Loud, punchy AKM gunfire with heavy bass and echo across the open fields. Bullets snap and crack as they pass close by, and a heavy thud plays when the player is hit. Brass casings clatter on the concrete floor and dirt. Footsteps change from dirt to concrete to creaking wooden stairs to rustling wheat. Bullet impacts hit brick, steel and earth. Hit marker ticks sound on each hit. The smoke grenade pops and hisses. A heavy magazine swap and a charging-handle rack. Soft UI clicks and item pickup sounds play during looting: a cloth rustle for medical items, a metallic clank for the ammo, a hard plastic knock for the helmet and a heavy weapon rattle for the sniper rifle. The bandage tears and wraps, and the energy drink can snaps open with a fizz and a gulp. Constant distant gunfire and explosions roll across the map. Enemies shout and scream in pain when hit, with wordless yells and battle cries and no clear words. The player breathes heavily after the fight and calms down while healing. No music.
