author: @openclipsai
text: Cinematic 10-second shot in an elegant Art Deco cocktail bar at night, warm golden light, dark green velvet and brass. A tall champagne tower of crystal coupe glasses, six levels, stands on a marble bar. A young waitress in a black satin dress stands beside it holding a gold-foil champagne bottle and slowly pours into the top glass; champagne overflows and cascades down the levels, sparkling in the light. Camera slowly pushes in at eye level. Halfway through, one glass on the bottom row slips out of place and the whole tower wobbles, leans and topples over in dramatic slow motion: the glasses tumble and roll across the marble bar, champagne splashes everywhere in a golden spray, bubbles and droplets catch the light. She freezes with the bottle still raised, eyes wide in surprise, then bursts into laughter and covers her mouth with her free hand. Playful, glamorous, realistic physics of glass and liquid, photorealistic, shallow depth of field.

author: @openclipsai
text:
[Point of view] THE CAMERA IS THE DRONE. This is a pure first-person FPV view: the viewer sees exactly what the drone's lens sees, and nothing of the drone itself ever appears. The frame holds only the ocean, the wave, the surfer, spray and sky. No propellers, arms, drone body, gimbal, landing gear, drone shadow on the water or any other aircraft are ever in view.

[Scene] Golden late-afternoon sun over a deep blue tropical ocean. Photorealistic water with real foam, spray, reflections and light.

[Action] The camera skims fast and low, half a metre above the glassy sea, racing toward a huge turquoise wave that rises and curls from frame-right to frame-left. A surfer in black board shorts on a white surfboard drops down the steep face just ahead of the camera, crouched low, his left hand trailing along the wall of water. The lip of the wave pitches over and closes into a hollow tube, and the camera follows the surfer inside the tunnel, sunlight glowing green through the curved water above. Inside the tube, fine spray speckles the lens and the round opening of bright sky grows ahead. The wave exhales a thick curtain of white spray across the exit, and the camera punches through it right behind the surfer. They burst out into blinding sunshine, and the surfer straightens up on the board and raises his right arm high. The camera banks up and to the right, rising above him, and the shot ends wide on the surfer riding the shoulder of the wave with his arm in the air, the sun low on the horizon.

[Sound] Roaring wave, hissing spray, rushing wind, water droplets tapping the lens, a joyful shout from the surfer as he exits the tube.

author: fal.ai
text: Create a small handmade stop-motion tea party. Keep the white rabbit in a pink dress on the left, the brown bear in a blue shirt in the center, and the white-and-orange cat in yellow on the right. Preserve their stitched faces, rosy cheeks, fuzzy wool surfaces, and rounded proportions.

author: kling4.video
text: Night in a narrow Osaka alley after heavy rain. Low tracking shot following a courier in a yellow raincoat who pushes a bicycle through puddles that mirror pink and teal neon signs. Steam drifts from a ramen shop vent. The camera slowly rises to reveal the tangle of overhead cables. Sound: rain dripping from awnings, a distant train, the bicycle chain ticking. Anamorphic look, shallow depth of field.

author: kling4.video
text: Two shots. Shot 1 (0-5s): close-up through a train window, a woman in a camel coat presses her palm to the glass, eyes wet. Shot 2 (5-10s): reverse angle from inside the carriage, a man on the snowy platform walks alongside as the train starts moving, then stops and raises his hand. Sound: a train horn, wheels starting to turn, a muffled station announcement.

author: kling4.video
text: Handheld follow shot at golden hour. A parkour runner in a grey hoodie sprints across a concrete rooftop, vaults a ventilation duct and leaps the gap to the next building. The camera follows over the edge as the street drops away below; he lands in a roll and dust kicks up. Sound: fast footsteps, heavy breathing, a rush of wind.

author: kling4.video
text: Medium shot in a small, busy café. A nervous young barista with a short bob looks toward a customer just off-screen left and says in English: "Sorry, was that oat milk or almond?" The customer laughs off-screen: "Surprise me." She smiles with relief and reaches for a carton. Sound: espresso machine hiss and café chatter. Natural window light, lips in sync with the speech.

author: kling4.video
text: Vertical handheld shot for a social feed. A street-food cook tosses noodles in a flaming wok at a night market; flames leap up, he slides the noodles onto a banana leaf, looks into the camera with a grin and asks: "Spicy?" Sound: sizzling oil, crackling flames, market noise.

author: kling4.video
text: Studio product shot. A matte sage-green ceramic mug on a walnut table, soft window light from the left. Hot coffee pours in from above in a smooth arc, a wisp of steam curls up, and the camera slowly orbits 45 degrees around the mug. Sound: liquid pouring, a soft ceramic clink. Clean, warm, commercial look, no text on screen.

author: kling4.video
text: Macro close-up of hands pleating a dumpling on a floured wooden board, then placing it in a bamboo steamer beside five others. The lid closes and steam bursts out around its edges. Sound: soft dough being pressed, then a hiss of steam. Warm tungsten light, shallow focus.

author: kling4.video
text: Aerial drone shot at dawn over a glacier lagoon. Blue icebergs drift on still, dark water that reflects a pink sky. The drone glides forward low over the water, then tilts up as the sun breaks over the mountains. Sound: steady wind and the faint crack of ice.

author: kling4.video
text: Slow dolly-in through the doors of a brutalist concrete library: a tall reading hall where skylights cut sharp beams of light across rows of oak desks, and a single reader turns a page. The camera keeps pushing toward the far window. Sound: echoing footsteps, a page turning, a quiet ventilation hum.

author: kling4.video
text: Paper-cut stop-motion style. A small orange paper fox trots through layered paper pine trees under a cut-paper moon. The layers shift with parallax as the camera trucks sideways. Snowflakes made of white paper confetti fall slowly. Sound: soft paper rustling and a gentle music-box melody.

author: kling4.video
text: Wide shot at dusk over a fishing village. An enormous whale made of glowing paper lanterns swims slowly through the clouds above the rooftops while villagers look up from the harbour. The camera tilts up from the boats to follow the whale's tail. Sound: low whale song, lapping waves, a child gasping.

author: kling4.video
text: Inside a dome greenhouse on Mars, a red dust storm visible through the curved glass. An astronaut in a white suit, helmet off, checks a tomato plant and taps a tablet; the grow lights shift from white to magenta. Slow push-in. Sound: storm wind against the glass, soft electronic beeps.

author: @sebatheepan
text:
A storm surge detonates against a concrete sea wall and the entire structure shudders through to its foundation.
Shot 1 — 0.0s to 5.0s — WS, low angle looking up from the waterline, crane mount. At 0.0s the frame is already wet: a brutalist concrete tidal barrier runs from frame left toward a vanishing point right, its vertical buttress fins stained dark by decades of salt, and a single sodium floodlight on a rusted mast burns orange against a bruised graphite sky. A swell arrives from behind camera and the first fraction of it — a wall of grey-green water, no crest, freight-train mass — climbs the parapet at 0.6s and detonates over it at 1.4s into a sheet of white spray that crosses the whole frame. The crane lifts with the impact at 1.2 m/s, rising from just above the waterline toward eye height on the parapet. Spray hangs airborne after the surge retreats, thinning slowly across the floodlight beam.
Hard cut.
Shot 2 — 5.0s to 10.5s — MCU, low, locked-off at the parapet. The last of the water drains back through the expansion joints in vertical ropes, and the retreat drags debris on gravity rather than wind: a length of splintered timber, a burst orange buoy, a scatter of stone aggregate, each tumbling with rotation and settling where physics puts it against the buttress fins. Residual water sheets off the concrete in one continuous film, then breaks into drips. Two gulls cross frame right to left, small and unhurried, and are gone.
Hard cut.
Shot 3 — 10.5s to 15.0s — EWS, high angle looking down from behind and above the barrier, slow dolly forward at 0.3 m/s. The ocean beyond is still working — long ground swell lines stacked to the horizon under the bruised sky — while the barrier itself has gone motionless and the suspended spray from the impact turns slowly in the floodlight beam. Nothing settles twice; the scene arrives at stillness with the water still moving behind it.
Camera law: 24mm anamorphic; movement family is crane rise at 1.2 m/s through shot one, locked-off through shot two, slow dolly forward at 0.3 m/s through shot three; the camera stays low for shots one and two and lifts above the parapet line only for shot three; 180 degree motion blur. Anti-default: droplets on the lens glass in the near foreground of shot two, defocused, never wiped.
Grade and audio: storm-desat palette — graphite, sodium-orange, cold grey-green — contrast pushed high with blacks crushed. Key light is the single sodium floodlight on the rusted mast, halation blooming where it burns through suspended spray. A gale ambient bed under five diegetic events — deep water impact on concrete, spray hiss across stone, water draining through expansion joints, timber cracking against the barrier, a distant fog signal.
Constraints: Count of people in frame: zero. Count of gulls: two. Count of light sources: one. No music, no score, no bgm. No subtitles.

A gantry crane walks a loaded shipping container across a working port at last light, and the camera never leaves it.

Shot 1 — 0.0s to 10.0s — one continuous unbroken take, WS opening to MCU, crane-mounted arc into a dolly-zoom, subject held in the right third. At 0.0s the frame sits inside the machinery's own logic: a blue-grey container hangs twelve metres above quay level on four steel cables that are the only diagonal in a composition built from horizontals — stacked containers running to the frame edge, a flat leaden canal, a hard horizon. At 1.2s the trolley travels right along the gantry boom at 1.0 m/s and the camera arcs with it; the cables pass from slack to taut and the container answers with a slow pendulum that gravity kills by 3.0s. Below, a stub of loose tarpaulin on a container roof lifts and folds in the crosswind, then drops. At 6.0s the trolley brakes, the container floats its last half metre of travel, and the cables hand the load's momentum to the frame as a single lurch the camera takes rather than hides. At 8.0s the lens dolly-zooms into the container's corrugated face, the world flattening and compressing against the steel, and holds to the end while the port keeps working behind it.

Camera law: 35mm anamorphic, one continuous unbroken take with no cut and no gap; movement family is a crane-mounted arc at 1.0 m/s through the travel, then a dolly-zoom for the final beat; height holds just above container-roof level, high angle looking down on the quay, never eye level with the machinery; 180 degree motion blur. Anti-default: a defocused steel cable passes within twenty centimetres of the lens twice during the arc, and neither pass is wiped.

Grade and audio: cool-daylight palette — leaden blue, rust-brown, sodium-amber — contrast soft lifted blacks. Key light is the dying sun low behind the gantry, halation blooming through salt haze and diesel exhaust. Port rumble and water slap as the bed under five diegetic events — steel cable loading, trolley motor, a container meeting its quay guide, crosswind through tarpaulin, a far ship's horn.

Constraints: Count of cuts: zero. Count of people in frame: zero. No music, no score, no bgm. No subtitles.

Test 3 — macro material physics (9:16 vertical, 1080p, 6s) Hypothesis: how far down the scale does the physics hold — surface tension, caustics, a rebound droplet — and does it handle vertical framing?

A single droplet of water falls into a still black pool and the surface answers it.Shot 1 — 0.0s to 6.0s — ECU macro, eye level with the waterline, locked-off. At 0.0s the frame holds a still black water surface across the lower third, its meniscus drawn as one bright curve against a matte grey background. A single droplet hangs in the upper frame, out of focus, then falls. At 1.4s it strikes the surface and the impact throws a crown of water upward in real time, crisp-edged rather than blurred; the crown collapses inward on itself by 2.4s and a rebound droplet rises out of the collapse, hangs briefly at 2.6s, and falls back at 4.1s. Ripples run outward and reach the frame edge at 5.4s, and the surface settles into stillness indistinguishable from frame one.

Camera law: 100mm macro at minimum focus distance, locked-off, no camera move; the plane of focus sits exactly on the meniscus and depth of field is razor thin; 1/2000s shutter so droplet edges stay crisp through the fastest motion. Anti-default: a defocused beaker rim occupies the left fifteen percent of the frame, close to the lens, and is never racked away.Grade and audio: cool-daylight palette — black, steel-blue, one white specular — contrast low-key deep shadow. Key light is a single soft source directly above the pool, halation blooming on the specular highlight. Room tone as the bed under five diegetic events — surface tension snapping, impact into the pool, crown collapse, the rebound droplet returning, ripples sheeting across still water.Constraints: Count of cuts: zero. Count of droplets: one. Count of people in frame: zero. No music, no score, no bgm. No subtitles.

author: @NigelWatsonTFTC
text: A street musician sits alone on wet pavement at night under a single streetlight. He plays a violin. The violin slowly cracks and falls silent. As the pieces break, they lift into the air and reassemble into floating, glowing shards that continue the melody. Slow continuous camera move, rain and neon reflections stay consistent. Emotional, restrained, 20 seconds.

author: @FlyAIgh
text:
A coastal city at dusk. Realistic disaster-film look, 16:9 widescreen framing, a huge sense of scale. 25 seconds in total, five shots. No main characters, only a few small passers-by in the distance.

Shot 1 (0 to 5s, wide, slow push-in): a seafront boulevard at dusk, palm trees moving in the sea breeze, the sea still calm. On the horizon the moon is three times its usual size and still slowly growing. The camera pushes forward slowly from low on the boulevard. A few passers-by stop and look up at the moon.

Shot 2 (5 to 10s, close, hard cut): a parked car at the roadside. A raindrop on its roof starts to float upward, then gravel, leaves and drink cans leave the ground one after another and drift slowly skyward. A lamppost gives off a metallic hum.

Shot 3 (10 to 15s, extreme wide, hard cut): the moon now fills half the sky, its craters and rifts sharp. The sea is pulled up by the moon's gravity, the whole surface bulging upward into a leaning wall of water at the edge of the city, ships lifted into the air.

Shot 4 (15 to 21s, tracking, hard cut): weightlessness grows stronger. Cars on the street leave the ground one after another and tumble upward, billboards tear off the rooftops, palm trees are pulled out by the roots. The camera moves like a drone, threading between the floating cars and rising higher and higher.

Shot 5 (21 to 25s, looking up, hard cut): the camera stops among the floating debris and looks straight up. The craters fill the frame and keep coming closer, the ridges in the shadows clearly visible, until the lunar surface fills the frame completely.

Sound: waves and wind at the start. When weightlessness begins, a rising low hum drowns out everything. Metal creaks as the cars leave the ground. At the end only a huge low rumble, then sudden silence. No background music.

No subtitles, no watermark.

author: @SilentNightX97
text:
Cinematic 15-second realistic action stunt fight scene, ARRI Alexa 32mm lens, shallow-to-deep depth of field, handheld camera with natural shake and occasional whip pans, natural warehouse lighting with dusty skylight beams, cool desaturated grade with warm lamp accents, subtle motion blur, practical stunt realism, no wire-work, no CGI enhancement.

SETTING: Large dusty warehouse, metal shelving stacked with boxes and wooden pallets, concrete floor with scattered debris, shafts of light cutting through a high window.

0-2s: Wide static shot with slight push-in. Two men in their late 20s stand facing each other, breathing hard, sweat on their foreheads, fists raised. Dust floats in the light beams.
Man A (low, steady, dangerous): "Last chance. Walk away."
Man B (grinning, out of breath): "You first."

2-5s: Handheld medium shot at a 45° angle. Man A lunges forward with a straight right punch — Man B slips it, blocks with his forearm, counters with a body shot into A's ribs. A grunts, twists away. Real physical impact, natural body weight, feet planted with realistic footwork, no floating motion.

5-8s: Low-angle wide shot at ground level. Man B throws a knee — Man A jumps back, B pivots and drives an elbow into A's shoulder, shoving A hard into a metal shelving unit. The shelf rattles, boxes shift. Camera shakes on impact.

8-11s: Handheld close-up with slight Dutch angle. Man A grabs Man B by the collar and slams him against the wall — dust puffs from the concrete, boxes tumble off the shelf and crash to the floor. Man B grabs A's throat in return, both grappling, breathing ragged, faces inches apart, real strain in their arms and necks.

11-13s: Whip pan with a speed-ramp into 0.5x slow motion. Man A lands a sharp elbow strike to Man B's jaw. Man B's head snaps back, his body spins and he crashes down onto a stack of wooden pallets — real impact, real weight, pallets crack and shift, dust bursts up around him.

13-15s: Static wide shot with a slow push-in. Man B lies on the pallets, chest heaving, one hand twitching. Man A stands over him, shoulders rising and falling, blood at the corner of his mouth, dust settling around them both in the light beam. Fade to black.

NATURAL REALISM: realistic fight choreography with proper weight transfer and momentum, natural footwork, real physical contact and impact recoil, realistic skin texture with sweat and dirt, natural micro-expressions of pain and exhaustion, natural English dialogue with lip-sync, ambient warehouse sound — echoing footsteps, metal rattling, boxes crashing, heavy breathing, no stiff movement, no robotic motion, no cartoon physics, no over-choreographed wire-fu.

title_zh: 罗马尼亚民间黑暗喜剧
author: @airina_xyz
text:
KLING 4.0 — 20-SECOND ROMANIAN FOLKLORE DARK COMEDY, 16:9, FIVE SHOTS.

VISUAL STYLE: Authentic 1977 Romanian-Czechoslovak live-action fairy-tale movie, imaginative handmade costumes, grotesque practical prosthetic makeup, soft 35mm film grain, faded analog color, atmospheric Carpathian woodland.

CHARACTERS:
BABA CLOANȚA: An ancient, hunched Romanian witch with a gigantic hooked nose, warts, enormous pointed ears, almost toothless mouth and glittering mischievous eyes. Multiple layers of ragged wool, old beads, dried herbs and tiny copper bells. Irritable, cunning, unexpectedly affectionate.

THE PRINCE: A handsome but painfully nervous young man, age 25, wearing a faded blue medieval doublet, a velvet cap and an oversized sword. Frightened of practically everything.

SETTING: Outside a ramshackle wooden witch's cottage deep in a misty Romanian forest. Twisted roots, mossy stones, bundles of dried herbs, a rough wooden counter.

DIALOGUE: Romanian only, naturally spoken with authentic Romanian pronunciation.

0:00–0:03 — MEDIUM CLOSE-UP: The prince rushes toward Baba Cloanța, breathless. He cries, "Mă urmărește un blestem!" His eyes dart around the trees.

0:03–0:07 — CLOSE-UP: The witch grins and holds up a tiny antique brass bell on a red string. She says mysteriously, "Sună când ești în primejdie."

0:07–0:11 — DETAIL SHOT: The prince takes the bell. Instantly it begins ringing violently in his hand. He looks at it, terrified.

0:11–0:15 — MEDIUM TWO-SHOT: The prince frantically shakes the bell and asks, "E stricat?" Baba Cloanța tilts her enormous head and studies him.

0:15–0:20 — EXTREME CLOSE-UP: The witch leans toward the prince until her grotesque face nearly fills the frame. She smiles with all three remaining teeth and whispers tenderly, "Nu, dragule. Sunt chiar aici." The prince slowly realizes what she means. His eyes widen. The bell rings faster. Cut to black at 20 seconds.

PERFORMANCE: Distinctive practical-makeup facial expressions, convincing frightened reactions, excellent timing. The witch is genuinely amused, never cartoonishly frantic.

CAMERA: Natural 1970s film coverage, restrained movements, expressive close-ups, clear continuity.

AUDIO: Romanian dialogue, creaking woodland branches, distant crows, wind, footsteps, increasingly frantic small brass bell. No music, no narrator, no subtitles.

author: @su_nagomi
text: 【30秒｜16:9｜3Dキネティックタイポグラフィ×ポップアート｜テーマ：絶対に押すな！｜BGM無し／SEあり／日本語文字を正確に表示】 【全体仕様】1920×1080、30fps、極太3Dゴシック体、赤・黄・ピンク・青・白の鮮やかな配色。文字は光沢のある立体樹脂素材。文字そのものが意思を持って動き、伸縮・衝突・回転・飛散・再結合する。カメラは高速ドリー、ウィップパン、マクロ、ローアングルを使い分ける。スタジオ照明と漫画的な集中線を組み合わせる。画面転換は文字の衝突や動きと同期。主役の赤いボタンは1個だけで、黒と黄色の警告ストライプ付き台座に固定。文字の形状・赤ボタンの構造・奥行き関係を全カットで統一。背景色は切り替えても空間配置の矛盾を起こさない。日本語は文字化け・不要文字・複製を禁止。音楽なし、コミカルなSEをアクションに完全同期。 CUT1【0:00–0:03】Visuals：真っ白なスタジオ空間。中央奥に巨大な赤い立体文字「絶対に押すな！」。中央手前に赤いボタン。Camera：50mm/f4、ゆっくりドリーイン。Lighting：白いソフトボックス光、床に柔らかな影。Motion：文字は静止。ただし「押」だけが一瞬小さく震える。SE：静寂→「ピッ」。Emotion：禁止されたものへの好奇心。Transition：ボタンへマッチカット。 CUT2【0:03–0:06】Visuals：ボタンのマクロショット。赤い表面に光が走る。奥の巨大文字「押」が左右を見回すように傾く。Camera：85mm Macro/f2.8、低い視点からボタンへ接近。Lighting：艶やかな白いハイライト。Motion：「押」の文字が元の配置からわずかに前へ傾く。SE：「ピッ、ピッ」、小さなゴムの軋み音。Transition：文字「押」へウィップパン。 CUT3【0:06–0:09】Visuals：「押」が文字列から抜け出し、ボタンへ向かって少しずつ前進。残った文字「す」「な」「！」が慌てたように震える。Camera：35mm/f4、斜め45度の立体構図、横方向トラッキング。Lighting：黄色のアクセント光。Motion：「押」が小さくジャンプしながらボタンへ近づき、「す」が横から阻止しようと傾く。SE：「ピョコ、ピョコ」「キュッ！」。Transition：「押」がジャンプした頂点で切り替え。 CUT4【0:09–0:12】Visuals：「押」がボタンの真上に浮く。一瞬、時間が止まる。次の瞬間、真下へ落下してボタンを押す。Camera：最初は真横のクローズアップ、押下時に広角28mmへ衝撃カット。Lighting：押下の瞬間に強烈な黄色の発光。Motion：「押」の着地→ボタン沈下→床面から衝撃波が広がる。SE：直前0.4秒無音→「ポチッ！」「ドカーン！」。Transition：衝撃波が画面を覆う。 CUT5【0:12–0:15】Visuals：背景が鮮烈な黄色へ変化。巨大な「えっ!?」が画面奥から飛び出し、周囲の文字を弾き飛ばす。Camera：24mm/f5.6、急激なドリーズーム。Lighting：明るいスタジオ光、文字の縁に白いリムライト。Motion：「えっ!?」が激しくバウンドし、スクワッシュ＆ストレッチで伸び縮み。SE：「バイーン！」「ポヨン！」。Transition：巨大文字がカメラ前を横切ってワイプ。 CUT6【0:15–0:19】Visuals：背景がビビッドピンクへ。文字たちがピンボールのように飛び回る。赤いボタンは床中央に固定されたまま。文字「押」が再びボタンへ突進して周囲の文字がパニックになる。Camera：35mm/f5.6、左右ウィップパンと素早い引き。Lighting：白いキーライト＋マゼンタのリムライト。Motion：文字が衝突・反発・回転。動く文字は手前と奥の2群に分け、視認性を保つ。SE：「ドン！」「バン！」「ビヨーン！」「カン！」。Transition：「押」がボタンに再衝突した衝撃で次へ。 CUT7【0:19–0:22】Visuals：背景が赤い警告空間へ。巨大な白い3D文字「押した…」が画面いっぱいに迫る。周囲を赤い警告灯が回る。Camera：45mm/f4、高速ドリーインから急停止。Lighting：赤い警告光と白い正面光。Motion：「押した…」が膨張し、重さに耐えられず下方向へ潰れる。SE：短いサイレン「ウーウー！」→重低音「ズシン！」。Transition：文字が画面を押し潰して青背景へ切り替え。 CUT8【0:22–0:25】Visuals：一転して静かな青背景。巨大な白い文字「だから言ったのに」が整列。床には疲れたように転がる「押」。Camera：50mm/f4、正面固定から軽いプッシュイン。Lighting：明るいクールホワイト。Motion：「だから言ったのに」が呆れたように左右へゆっくりウェーブ。「押」が小さく震える。SE：「ハァ〜……」「コロン」。Emotion：笑えるツッコミ。Transition：床から文字の破片が吸い上がる。 CUT9【0:25–0:28】Visuals：散らばった文字が渦を巻き、吸い寄せられて元の「絶対に押すな！」へ再結合。背景は白に戻る。Camera：35mm/f4、周囲をわずかに回り込みながら正面位置へ復帰。Lighting：清潔な白いスタジオ光。Motion：文字が一個ずつ元の場所に戻り、最後に「押」がはまる。SE：「シュルルル！」「カチカチカチ！」「ポン！」。Transition：完成と同時に静止。 CUT10【0:28–0:30】Visuals：CUT1と完全に同じ構図。元通りの「絶対に押すな！」と赤ボタン。安心した直後、「押」の文字だけが再びボタンに向かってわずかに傾く。Camera：50mm/f4、正面固定。Lighting：CUT1と一致。Motion：「押」の小さな傾き→ボタンが一度点滅。SE：短い沈黙→「ピッ」。Emotion：また押すのか！という予感。Transition：暗転なしでCUT1へ自然にループ。 【最重要の破綻防止】「押」は文字列から抜け出した同一個体として扱う。文字が増殖しない。ボタンは1個で位置固定。ボタンを押す瞬間は接触・沈下・反発の順序を守る。背景色変更は編集上のカット切り替えで行い、物理空間を不自然に変形させない。文字の輪郭・書体・厚みを統一。動きのピークは15〜22秒、ラストは静かに締める。最後の構図を冒頭と一致させる。。

The video is captured entirely through an early smartphone front-facing camera (like iPhone 4 era), featuring authentic 2010 mobile livestream aesthetics: heavy pixelation, low resolution, digital compression artifacts, grainy texture, and slightly shaky handheld movements.

Scene 1 — Welcome to the Live (0–5 seconds)
Choi Yu-na stands inside a 2010 style women's boutique with neon signage and racks filled with early 2010s fashion trends, wearing her signature black bomber jacket over a black top and gray pleated skirt. She holds her early smartphone at arm's length, smiling into the low res pixelated camera and greeting her viewers.

Dialogue: “Hey guys! Welcome to my mobile live stream! I'm here at the boutique today, and you guys have to see these new arrivals!”
She briefly pans the pixelated camera toward the clothing racks, then returns it to her face.

Scene 2 — Show the First Dress (5–10 seconds)

Dialogue: “Look at this color block dress! It's so hot right now, and the fabric is super cute for a night out!”
She squints slightly at the screen as if reading early mobile chat comments.

text:
THE NAMELESS EDGE
High-Adrenaline Dark Fantasy — Cinematic Movie Trailer

[VISUAL STYLE LOCK]

Ultra-realistic, premium live-action, epic dark fantasy movie trailer.

A lost 1960s–1970s sword-and-sorcery masterpiece, reimagined with the extraordinary scale, detail and realism of modern prestige cinema.

A world of ancient sorcery, decadent empires, cursed weapons, crumbling civilizations, terrifying supernatural entities, forgotten gods, black iron, bronze armor, ruined palaces, immense stone temples, violent medieval warfare, and cosmic horror.

The atmosphere is tragic, savage, mysterious, melancholic and overwhelming.

CINEMATOGRAPHY LOCK

Shot on ARRI Alexa XT with Camtec Vintage Ultra Prime lenses. 35mm Kodak film aesthetic.

Hazy, low-contrast cinematography. Muted earthy colors. Heavy analog film grain. Mild chromatic aberration. Slight lens vignette. Soft highlight bloom. Organic optical imperfections.

Indie-cinematic framing with large negative space, off-center compositions, naturalistic blocking, dramatic silhouettes and unusually deep environmental compositions.

Aggressive rack-focus transitions, handheld documentary-style camera movement, sudden whip-pans, imperfect crash zooms, violent camera vibration, rapid low-angle tracking shots, shaky shoulder-mounted combat photography.

Naturalistic lighting, practical fire, pale moonlight, thick atmospheric fog, volumetric smoke, heavy rain, blowing ash, realistic dust, layered focus and physical debris.

The production should feel like an authentic, enormously expensive historical fantasy epic with practical locations, colossal physical sets, realistic costumes, tangible weapons, massive armies and convincing old-school creature effects.

No glossy videogame rendering, cartoon physics, superhero aesthetics, modern tactical costumes, futuristic technology or polished digital magic.

Magic should look frightening, unnatural, ancient and physically integrated with the real world.

MUSIC AND EDITING LOCK

Use @Video 1 as the exact musical track.

Create an EXTREMELY HIGH-ADRENALINE, HIGH-PACING cinematic trailer.

Cut tightly to the actual percussion, musical accents, instrumental transitions, rhythmic subdivisions and climactic impacts of the soundtrack.

Use violent hard cuts on heavy beats, rapid 3–6-shot montages during faster passages, and unexpected half-second moments of silence or visual stillness before the largest musical explosions.

Every important beat should correspond to a sword impact, bodily movement, explosion, camera transition, supernatural event or dramatic reveal.

Dynamic action match-cuts between locations. Weapons, arrows, falling objects, smoke, flowing cloaks and flying debris can bridge consecutive shots.

The editing should build in intensity until the final sequence becomes an overwhelming collision of medieval war, supernatural terror and personal tragedy.

No narration or spoken dialogue is necessary.

ORIGINAL WORLD AND CHARACTER LOCK

The setting is a fictional dying continent where ancient kingdoms survive among the colossal fossilized remains of creatures that once ruled the oceans.

An expanding religious military empire conquers the continent using armies, massive siege engines and enormous ritual bells that can alter the physical world.

The protagonist is SAREN, a lean, battle-scarred former imperial war-scribe turned exile, in his late thirties. Weathered olive skin, short dark hair with a single premature gray streak, tired gray-green eyes, an old scar cutting across the bridge of his nose, and an exhausted, haunted expression.

He wears tarnished bronze scale armor, weather-beaten black leather, layered dark cloth and a faded deep-red traveling cloak.

He is not a conventional heroic warrior. His strength comes from desperation, experience and a supernatural weapon he fears.

His weapon is THE NAMELESS EDGE.

A massive, ancient, charcoal-colored sword forged from the metal of a shattered ceremonial bell.

Its blade is broad and uneven, marked by strange concentric engravings and fine golden fractures within the dark iron.

The sword is sentient but never speaks in human language.

When drawn, it emits an almost inaudible metallic toll that causes nearby flames to flicker and loose objects to tremble.

Every time Saren uses its supernatural strength, the sword consumes one of HIS OWN memories.

The greater the violence, the more important the memory it takes.

His victories gradually erase his identity.

His closest companion is IVA, an itinerant astronomer and battlefield healer who carries a collection of small engraved bronze tokens. Each token records a memory Saren has already lost.

The antagonist is THE CHOIR MARSHAL, the masked commander of a religious empire whose soldiers march beneath enormous mobile bell towers.

These figures, their appearances, relationships, history and supernatural mechanics are entirely original.

THE TRAILER

BLACK.

An immense metallic object vibrates in darkness.

A thin crack travels across its surface.

The camera pulls backward.

It is an ancient BRONZE BELL.

Half buried in black sand.

Its broken surface is covered in forgotten inscriptions.

One enormous fracture splits the metal from top to bottom.

A pale human hand enters frame.

Fingers touch the crack.

The first musical impact.

HARD CUT.

EXTREME CLOSE-UP.

A weathered man's eye opens.

SAREN.

His face is covered in dust and dried blood.

A violent explosion illuminates his features.

He turns.

The camera rack-focuses past his face.

Behind him, an enormous ancient city is burning.

THE CITY OF VARN.

An impossible settlement built among the colossal fossilized ribs of a prehistoric sea creature.

Black stone towers rise between enormous white bones.

Suspended bridges connect crooked palaces.

Huge bronze bells hang from monumental archways.

Armies pour through its breached gates.

The music accelerates.

HARD CUT.

A cavalry rider charges directly toward camera.

CUT.

Horse hooves strike wet black mud.

CUT.

A bronze-armored soldier raises an executioner's axe.

CUT.

Saren pulls his enormous charcoal-black sword from its scabbard.

The metal produces a deep, unnatural vibration.

CUT ON THE BEAT.

The axe comes down.

Saren catches the strike with the flat of his blade.

METAL EXPLODES INTO SPARKS.

The handheld camera violently recoils.

Saren twists and drives his shoulder into the attacker.

The soldier stumbles backward.

Saren swings the blade.

A tremendous impact.

The soldier falls.

For an instant the battle continues normally.

Then—

An enormous bronze bell somewhere above the battlefield begins shaking.

Its clapper is completely motionless.

A strange ripple passes through the air.

The sword's golden fractures glow faintly.

Saren gasps.

A MEMORY FLASH.

A young child laughing in sunlight.

A wooden house overlooking green fields.

A woman's hand closing around his.

The images become violently fragmented.

Then DISAPPEAR.

Saren staggers.

He looks at a small portrait tied to his wrist.

The expression on his face changes.

He no longer recognizes the person depicted.

THE MUSIC STRIKES HARDER.

A violent whip-pan follows Saren as he turns toward another attacker.

CUT.

An imperial cavalry formation charges through a narrow canyon.

CUT.

Massive siege wheels crush abandoned wagons.

CUT.

A city gate disintegrates beneath a giant bronze battering ram.

CUT.

An armored soldier is hurled across a courtyard.

CUT.

A blade scrapes violently along a stone wall.

CUT.

Saren runs through a collapsing hallway.

Burning beams crash behind him.

The camera retreats backward at full speed, struggling to hold focus on his face.

He jumps over a fallen column.

A shower of sparks crosses the lens.

MATCH CUT.

The sparks become STARS.

A vast desert at night.

IVA stands atop a ruined astronomical observatory.

She is a young woman with wind-tangled black hair, weathered traveling clothes, faded blue robes beneath light leather armor, and a collection of small bronze memory tokens hanging from her belt.

She looks upward.

The stars begin moving.

Not across the sky.

TOWARD EACH OTHER.

Entire constellations twist into unfamiliar patterns.

Iva raises a brass astronomical instrument.

The instrument suddenly CRACKS.

A low metallic vibration travels across the desert.

The camera whip-pans toward the horizon.

An immense line of IMPERIAL BELL TOWERS is crossing the dunes.

Thousands of soldiers march beneath them.

Each siege tower carries a different enormous bronze bell.

The bells begin swinging.

None produces an audible sound.

But the dunes tremble.

The sky visibly darkens.

CUT ON THE NEXT BEAT.

THE CHOIR MARSHAL stands inside a gigantic ritual chamber.

A towering figure in dark bronze armor, a weathered ceremonial cloak and a smooth, elongated metal mask shaped like an abstract funerary face.

Behind him hang hundreds of small bells.

He raises his left hand.

Every bell stops moving.

He closes his fist.

A stone column across the chamber instantly SHATTERS.

The camera is struck by dust and falling fragments.

SMASH CUT.

Saren is running across a narrow bridge above a tremendous underground abyss.

Imperial soldiers pursue him.

The handheld camera races alongside.

A spear strikes the stone beside his foot.

He turns.

Swings his sword.

The bridge's supporting chain breaks.

Its huge iron links explode outward.

The bridge begins falling.

Saren leaps.

The camera leaps with him.

The bridge disintegrates behind them.

They FALL INTO DARKNESS.

The soundtrack enters a rapid sequence of beats.

The fall transforms into a violent MONTAGE.

A gigantic stone idol opening its sealed eyes.

A black-armored knight emerging from a burning doorway.

A woman's hand pressing an engraved bronze token into another hand.

An enormous desert creature dragging its armored body beneath the sand.

A line of imperial archers releasing hundreds of arrows simultaneously.

An ancient king's crown sinking into black water.

A chained prisoner screaming inside a chamber full of bells.

A temple ceiling collapsing as enormous stone figures move behind it.

A pale eclipse appearing above a battlefield.

A rusted sword thrust upward through thick mist.

A hundred horses rearing at exactly the same moment.

A monstrous stone face splitting open from within.

A close-up of THE NAMELESS EDGE.

Its golden fractures pulse.

The metallic vibration becomes almost unbearable.

HARD CUT.

Saren lands heavily on the floor of an ancient subterranean hall.

His knees buckle.

The camera drops with him.

Dust erupts from the impact.

He looks upward.

An enormous underground architecture stretches into darkness.

Gigantic fossilized bones form the vaults.

Ancient bronze mechanisms hang from chains hundreds of feet long.

At the center of the chamber is a colossal suspended bell, cracked and blackened by age.

Directly beneath it lies an altar.

Around the altar stand dozens of ancient suits of ceremonial armor.

EMPTY.

Their helmets slowly turn toward Saren.

All at once.

The music reaches another explosion.

THE ARMORS BEGIN MOVING.

A bronze sword strikes the floor beside Saren.

He rolls aside.

A second armored figure attacks.

He deflects the strike.

A third comes from behind.

Saren ducks.

The blade cuts through an ancient chain.

The chain whips across camera.

CUT.

EXT. DESERT — DAY.

An enormous iron chain snaps beneath the weight of a siege engine.

The machine tilts.

Its gigantic wheels buckle.

Soldiers scatter.

The entire structure tips sideways and crashes into the sand.

The impact sends a wall of dust toward camera.

CUT.

Saren and Iva run through the dust storm.

Behind them, an imperial army emerges in silhouette.

Iva looks backward.

An enormous figure rises through the dunes.

A SIX-LEGGED DESERT LEVIATHAN.

Its skin resembles cracked stone, covered in layers of rough mineral plates.

It has a wide, eyeless skull, enormous grinding jaws and a body scarred by centuries of desert erosion.

Its movements are heavy and animalistic.

Sand cascades from its shoulders.

It lowers its head.

A tremendous bellow shakes the landscape.

Imperial horses panic.

The creature charges through the army.

Armored bodies and wooden siege structures are thrown aside.

The camera runs at ground level between fleeing soldiers.

A soldier falls directly in front of the lens.

The camera stumbles.

A massive claw crashes into the earth.

CUT ON IMPACT.

Saren is thrown against a stone wall.

He falls to his knees.

Three imperial soldiers surround him.

He raises the sword.

A deep metallic vibration.

The weapon's golden fractures brighten.

The soldiers hesitate.

Saren begins moving with sudden, unnatural strength.

He strikes.

One shield breaks.

He pivots.

A spear is deflected.

A second soldier falls.

The camera circles him rapidly, imperfectly, staying close enough to feel the weight of every movement.

He delivers one final devastating blow.

A violent wave of displaced air erupts outward.

The surrounding soldiers are knocked backward.

Dust rises.

Saren stands motionless.

The sword vibrates in his hand.

Another memory is taken.

FLASH.

Iva smiling beside a campfire.

FLASH.

Iva bandaging his wounded shoulder.

FLASH.

Iva asleep during a long journey.

The images tear apart and disappear.

Saren looks at Iva.

She moves toward him.

He raises the sword defensively.

He DOES NOT RECOGNIZE HER.

The camera abruptly rack-focuses from his confused eyes to her devastated expression.

For half a second—

The music gives them space.

Iva reaches into her coat.

She takes out a small bronze token.

Engraved upon it is the image of two figures standing beneath a constellation.

She places it in Saren's empty hand.

His fingers close around it.

He stares at the engraving.

Then—

A distant bell TOLLS.

The music erupts into its MAIN CLIMAX.

HARD CUT.

A MASSIVE ARMY CHARGES DOWN A MOUNTAINSIDE.

Thousands of soldiers carrying black banners descend toward an ancient fortress.

CUT.

An enormous wooden siege tower catches fire.

CUT.

A giant stone statue falls from a temple roof.

CUT.

Imperial cavalry gallops through burning wheat fields.

CUT.

A monstrous desert leviathan bursts from the ground beneath a war machine.

CUT.

The Choir Marshal raises both arms beneath a gigantic bronze bell.

CUT.

Saren races up a staircase while the steps collapse behind him.

CUT.

Iva jumps from a crumbling balcony.

CUT.

Saren catches her with his free hand.

CUT.

A spear flashes across camera.

CUT.

Saren pulls Iva into a doorway just as the surrounding wall explodes.

CUT.

A tremendous storm forms above the city.

Enormous clouds twist around a black circular opening.

Ancient bells begin ringing throughout the continent.

Their sound is not heard.

Instead, the world physically REACTS.

Water rises from wells.

Dust moves upward.

Flames shrink into themselves.

Stone faces fracture.

Horses freeze in place.

A gigantic crack appears in the desert.

The camera whip-pans toward a fortress on the horizon.

ITS ENTIRE CENTRAL TOWER COLLAPSES.

CUT.

Saren stands on a high battlement overlooking the battle.

His sword hangs loosely in his right hand.

Far below, thousands of civilians flee through the gates of the city.

The imperial army closes in.

Iva reaches the battlement behind him.

She tries to grab his arm.

Saren looks toward her.

He recognizes the bronze token at her neck.

But not her face.

A tremendous dark cloud covers the sun.

Saren looks down at THE NAMELESS EDGE.

The sword trembles.

He knows what it wants.

He grips the weapon with both hands.

THE FINAL ASSAULT BEGINS.

Saren runs toward the edge of the battlement.

The camera accelerates beside him.

He leaps from the wall onto a collapsing siege platform.

The wooden structure breaks under his weight.

He rolls.

Rises.

Three enemies rush him.

The editing becomes brutally fast.

ONE BEAT — a sword strike.

NEXT BEAT — sparks across frame.

NEXT BEAT — an enemy shield breaks.

NEXT BEAT — Saren spins beneath a spear.

NEXT BEAT — his sword smashes against a helmet.

NEXT BEAT — a soldier falls backward into smoke.

NEXT BEAT — the camera crashes through the smoke with him.

Inside the smoke—

AN IMPOSSIBLE VISION.

Saren stands alone on an endless plain covered in shallow water.

A thousand enormous bells hang motionless in the black sky.

Beneath each bell stands a different version of Saren.

A child.

A soldier.

A prisoner.

An old man.

A stranger.

Every figure turns to look at him.

One by one, they disappear.

Each disappearance synchronized with a musical impact.

The water beneath Saren becomes BLACK.

He looks down.

His reflection has NO FACE.

SMASH CUT.

BACK TO THE BATTLEFIELD.

Saren screams and charges forward.

The sword's golden fractures erupt with pale light.

The ground splits beneath the enemy formation.

A massive shock wave throws soldiers and siege engines into the air.

The great imperial bells begin shattering.

One after another.

Each bell detonates on a separate musical beat.

Bronze fragments fill the sky.

The Choir Marshal stands beneath the final bell.

His smooth metal mask begins splitting.

A deep crack divides it vertically.

Inside the mask—

ABSOLUTE DARKNESS.

The final bell falls.

Its immense body crashes into the city.

The explosion sends an enormous circular wall of dust across the battlefield.

The camera retreats directly in front of Saren as the shock wave approaches.

He continues walking toward us.

His cloak tears in the wind.

His face is bloodied.

His armor is broken.

His sword has begun to crumble.

Iva runs toward him through the smoke.

The music reaches the FINAL RAPID IMPACTS.

CUT.

A collapsing throne of bronze and stone.

CUT.

A thousand imperial banners burning.

CUT.

An enormous shadow crossing the desert.

CUT.

The black sword fracturing from tip to hilt.

CUT.

A screaming mouth behind a cracked ceremonial mask.

CUT.

An ancient city swallowed by a wall of sand.

CUT.

The last bell shattering in midair.

CUT.

Saren falling to one knee.

CUT.

A bronze memory token tumbling through the air.

CUT.

Iva reaching toward him.

CUT.

The sword's final golden fracture going DARK.

For the last image—

A tight, trembling handheld close-up.

Saren is sitting among the ruins of the battlefield.

His sword lies broken beside him.

Iva kneels in front of him.

Her eyes are filled with tears.

She takes his hand.

He looks at her with the confused innocence of someone meeting a stranger.

She turns his palm upward.

Inside it lies the bronze token showing two figures beneath a constellation.

Saren studies the engraving.

He looks from the token to her face.

He opens his mouth.

He cannot remember her name.

The camera slowly rack-focuses away from their faces toward the broken sword lying in the foreground.

Even shattered, the weapon begins to VIBRATE.

A tiny golden fracture lights up.

THE FINAL MUSICAL IMPACT.

BLACK.

A stark title appears in tarnished silver lettering, surrounded by deep shadow and faint drifting ash.

THE NAMELESS EDGE

A final, distant metallic vibration.

Silence.

[FINAL PRODUCTION LOCK]

This is a fully original dark-fantasy film concept, not an adaptation or recreation of any existing fantasy franchise.

Maintain the atmosphere of vintage sword-and-sorcery paperback cover art, 1960s–1970s occult cinema, theatrical practical effects and grand historical adventure filmmaking.

Everything should feel discovered, ancient, physical and dangerous.

Make the cursed sword compelling through its material design, subtle movement, environmental reactions and tragic consequences, rather than exaggerated visual effects.

Saren's appearance must remain consistent in every scene: scarred, dark-haired, weathered, gaunt but physically capable, in worn bronze-and-leather armor with a faded crimson cloak.

The supernatural power must never turn the film into glossy high fantasy. Preserve believable weight, momentum, physical damage, natural human reactions and imperfect camera work.

Prioritize relentless rhythmic escalation, fast practical combat, dramatic silhouettes, massive physical scale, atmospheric depth and meaningful shot-to-shot continuity.

The most intense passages should consist of rapid, readable action fragments synchronised precisely to the music, while a handful of emotionally powerful close-ups establish the human cost of the sword.

The central idea is that a desperate warrior can save an entire civilization only by surrendering every memory of the people he wanted to save.

FINAL PRIORITY: Beat-perfect cuts, enormous sword-and-sorcery spectacle, aggressive organic handheld cinematography, terrifying ancient magic, genuine photorealism, and the atmosphere of a legendary lost 1970s dark-fantasy film.

30秒、16:9、1080p、8カット構成。
総製作費300億円規模の日本の実写大作映画を思わせる、シネマティックな超上級パルクール追跡シーン。
主役は、圧倒的な身体能力と優雅さを持つ女性怪盗。
女性怪盗のかっこいいパフォーマンスを映像の中心に据え、その後を同じルートで不器用に追う男性警察官の姿で、コミカルなアクセントを添える。
女性の技は踏み切りから空中姿勢、着地までしっかり見せる。男性の失敗で女性の見せ場を途中で遮らない。
画面の主役として女性を映す時間を全体の約7割とする。

【登場人物】
主人公は成人の女性怪盗。
添付画像の女性の顔立ち、輪郭、目元、鼻、口元、肌の色、髪型、髪色、年齢感、体格、服装、配色、アクセサリー、全体の雰囲気を忠実に維持する。
全カットを通して、添付画像と同じ女性だと明確に分かること。
怪盗らしさは、自信に満ちた表情、優雅な身のこなし、相手をからかう振る舞いで表現する。
参照画像にない仮面、帽子、マントなどを勝手に追加しない。

女性は世界トップレベルのフリーランニング能力を持つ。
力強い加速、無駄のない踏み切り、美しい空中姿勢、正確で静かな着地。
技と技の間で立ち止まらず、流れるように次の動作へつなぐ。
難しい技も涼しい顔で決め、追跡そのものを楽しんでいる。
振り返るときだけ、いたずらっぽい微笑みを見せる。

追いかけるのは、成人の男性警察官。
真面目で必死だが、運動神経が悪い。
女性と同じ障害物を、同じ順番、同じルートで越えようとする。
女性が跳び越えた障害物に腹を乗せ、女性が軽やかに登った壁を膝と肘でよじ登る。
女性の宙返りは真似できず、通常の跳躍で何とか同じ着地点へ進む。
不器用だが粘り強く、諦めない。
顔立ち、体格、制服を全カットで一貫させる。

【舞台・連続性】
快晴の現代日本の架空の都市。
屋上、路地、階段、手すり、配管、コンクリート壁、建物をつなぐ足場。
日本語の看板、室外機、屋上設備など、日本の都市らしい細部を自然に描く。
全8カットを、同じ街を連続して駆け抜ける1本の追跡劇としてつなぐ。
女性と男性が通る障害物の形状、位置、順序を一致させる。
男性は階段や別の通路へ迂回せず、女性のルートを不器用にたどる。
男性が手間取るほど距離が開く。女性が意図的に速度を緩めた場合だけ、距離が縮まる。
屋上の隙間は、女性には華麗な回転技を披露でき、男性にも全力の通常跳躍で何とか越えられる距離にする。

【カット1｜00:00〜00:04.00】
ローアングル後方追従から、女性の斜め前へ回り込む。
女性怪盗が肩越しに男性を振り返り、余裕の微笑み。
女性：「ついてこられるかしら？」
前へ向き直って一気に加速。
腰ほどの障害物へ両手をつき、脚を鮮やかに引き抜くコングヴォルト。
着地の勢いを保ち、そのまま次の壁へ走る。
男性は画面奥から同じ障害物へ迫る。

【カット2｜00:04.00〜00:07.50】
正面ローアングルの移動撮影。

すぐに踏み切り、キャットリープで高い壁の縁をつかむ。
腕と脚を連動させ、一息で壁の上へ身体を引き上げる。
上体を起こす流れで髪が風になびき、鋭い視線が次のルートを捉える。

片脚で強く踏み切り、ウェブスターで屋上の隙間を越える。
回転中も全身が見える構図を保ち、美しい伸びと身体の制御を見せる。
正確に着地し、勢いを途切れさせず走り続ける。
遠景の男性は同じルート上の壁を、肘と膝を使って必死によじ登っている。

【カット5｜00:15.00〜00:18.50】
俯瞰から地上に近い高さへ降りる移動カメラ。
女性が一段低い屋上へ飛び降り、滑らかなダイブロールで衝撃を吸収。
立ち上がる勢いのまま、長い手すりをスピードヴォルトで鮮やかに攻略する。

着地で深くしゃがみ込み、両手を床について踏みとどまる。

【カット6｜00:18.50〜00:22.00】

男性はようやく降り立つが、よろめいて帽子を押さえ、必死に追跡を再開する。
笑いのための間は短くし、女性の疾走感を維持する。

【カット7｜00:22.00〜00:26.00】
後方斜め上からのドローン撮影。
女性がパームスピンからコングヴォルトへ、滑らかに技をつなぐ。
最後のジャンプへ向かう直線で少しだけ速度を緩め、肩越しに振り返る。
女性：「あら、もうお疲れ？」
後方では男性が同じ配管の下を不格好にくぐり抜ける。

【カット8｜00:26.00〜00:30.00】
クライマックス。
女性が屋上の端へ向かって全力疾走。
力強く踏み切り、高く美しいコークスクリューで隙間を飛び越える。
空中でカメラが女性の周囲を滑らかに回り込み、顔、全身のシルエット、回転の軌道を捉える。
回転の頂点のみ、ごく短いスローモーション。
着地前に通常速度へ戻り、両足で正確に着地。そのまま走り抜ける。
最後に肩越しの微笑みを見せ、画面奥へ消える。
遠く後方では男性が、女性の通った障害物をまだ必死によじ登っている。
女性の圧倒的なかっこよさと、男性の諦めない追跡を同じワイド画面に収めて締める。

【映像・音響】
全編フォトリアルな実写。
大規模なロケ撮影、精密な美術、自然に溶け込むVFX、映画的なライティングとカラーグレーディング。
女性の技は、踏み切りから着地まで身体全体を見せる。
細かすぎる編集で動作をごまかさず、実際に技を連続して成功させている説得力を持たせる。
リアルな重心移動、筋肉の動き、着地衝撃。
髪や衣装が風と動きに合わせて自然に揺れる。
女性の表情には余裕があり、動きには速さ、力強さ、美しさがある。
男性の不器用さは、ためらい、弱い踏み切り、不安定な足運び、荒い息で表現する。
スタイリッシュで疾走感のある映画音楽。
女性の軽快な足音と、男性の重い着地音、衣擦れ、息遣いを対比させる。
セリフは指定された話者が自然な日本語で話し、口の動きを一致させる。
セリフ中は音楽を控え、聞き取りやすくする。
字幕、ナレーション、追加のアドリブは入れない。

【禁止】
添付画像の女性と別人になること。
女性の顔、髪型、服装、体格の変化。
参照画像にない怪盗衣装の追加。
女性の見せ場を男性の失敗で遮ること。
女性の技を途中で切り、踏み切りや着地を省略すること。
男性が別ルートへ迂回すること。
男性が突然機敏になること。
男性が高度な宙返りや華麗なヴォルトを成功させること。
男性が理由なく女性へ追いつくこと。
障害物の形状、位置、順序が変わること。
追う側と逃げる側の入れ替わり。
セリフの話者の入れ替わり、早口、セリフの重なり。
字幕、吹き出し。
顔や身体の崩れ、手足の増殖、分身、身体の融合、貫通。
電線の通過、ワープ、浮遊、不自然な着地。
漫画的な転倒や身体の変形。
アニメ調、イラスト調、ゲーム映像調、目立つ3DCG感。

author: @Iancu_ai
text:
STYLE FIRST: a real Japanese TV anime, like a scene from a seasonal anime opening. Hand-drawn character animation on twos and threes, hand-inked lines that change weight, flat cel color with one hard-edged shadow tone, painted anime background art with soft brush texture. Anime compositing only: gentle backlight bloom, light leaks at sunset, depth-of-field blur on painted layers, rain drawn as thin streaks. No 3D, no CG, no glossy skin or hair, no AI polish. This applies to every shot.

CHARACTER: use @[image1] as the character design sheet and match its hand-drawn look. Keep her face, violet eyes, very long straight pink hair with blunt bangs, white cropped high-neck top with black collar, oversized off-shoulder white techwear jacket with orange panels, black harness belt with white hip pouch, orange baggy cargo pants, one orange fingerless glove, white and orange sneakers. Her face stays on-model in every shot.

MAIN GOAL: a 30-second calm slice-of-life showcase, no fighting. One evening in a Japanese city from golden hour to the first star. 7 shots, each about 4 seconds, each a different classic anime shot type with one slow camera move. Hard cuts. Let every shot breathe, no rushing. Her hair and jacket always move in the wind.

(0–4.5s) SHOT 1, extreme wide: a city rooftop at golden hour, she sits on the railing edge, skyline and long orange sky behind her, wind lifting her hair. Slow push-in from far away.
(4.5–8.5s) SHOT 2, extreme close-up of her violet eyes, the sunset reflected in them, a strand of pink hair crossing her face. Rack focus from the hair strand to her eyes, then she blinks once.
(8.5–13s) SHOT 3, inside a commuter train: she stands by the window holding a strap, orange sunlight strobing across her face through passing poles. The camera tracks sideways with the train.
(13–17s) SHOT 4, insert close-up: her gloved hand on the train window as the first raindrops hit the glass, city lights blurring behind. Slow push-in on the hand.
(17–21.5s) SHOT 5, medium wide at a rainy bus stop at dusk: she is large in frame under the shelter beside a glowing vending machine, rain falling past the streetlight. She shakes rain off her sleeve and looks down the street. Slow pan toward her.
(21.5–25.5s) SHOT 6, low side angle from the ground: her reflection in a puddle, her sneaker steps in and sends ripples. The camera tilts up from the side and stops on her face.
(25.5–30s) SHOT 7, the rain stops. Side profile: she slowly tilts her head back and looks up, her chin lifting, as the clouds part and the first star appears in a deep blue sky. Slow crane up from her face to the sky and hold on the single star until the end.

Sound: city ambience only, wind, train, rain, the rain fading to quiet in the last shot. No music, no voice, no text, no subtitles, no watermark, no other characters.

text:
30-SECOND MODERN 2D ANIME ACTION COMEDY.. 16:9. SIX SHOTS.
KEPALA KETINGGALAN. Native sound. No dialogue or music.

[PURPOSE]
A CRT courier fights two thugs, escapes, then realizes one still holds his detachable television head. Readable action, awkward visual punchline.

[CHARACTERS]
CRT: lean adult mechanical humanoid, charcoal CRT head, ivory bezel, curved static screen, short antenna. Burgundy jacket, black trousers, white sneakers. Mechanical neck coupling, no human face.
A: broad adult Indonesian man, shaved head, black bomber, tan trousers.
B: lean adult Indonesian man, short black hair, grey hoodie, dark trousers.
Three fictional adults.

[LOCATION]
Jakarta parking garage, late afternoon. Concrete pillars, yellow wheel stops, distant apartments.
One grey scooter on its stand beside a pillar. Exit ramp right. Clear floor, no traffic or pedestrians.

[SCENE]
CRT stands beside his scooter. A blocks ahead; B approaches from the side. Hands empty, head attached. No helmet or loose props.

[SHOTS]
SHOT 1 | 00:00 TO 00:04
Low medium-wide, short lateral track right.
A grabs CRT's jacket collar with his RIGHT hand.
CRT traps that wrist with his LEFT hand and turns into the grip. B closes from the side. Jacket creak, shoe scrape.

SHOT 2 | 00:04 TO 00:10
Hard cut, stable side full shot.
CRT pulls A's wrist down and drives his RIGHT elbow into A's torso.
A folds forward and releases the jacket.
CRT steps clear, delivers ONE short side kick to A's middle and replants his foot.
A stumbles against a pillar and remains seated there, recovering. Clear contact and recoil. No extra strikes.

SHOT 3 | 00:10 TO 00:16
Hard cut, medium two-shot of CRT and B.
B lunges and grabs both sides of CRT's television casing.
CRT braces against B's forearms, turns and pulls his body down and backward.
The mechanical neck latch releases with ONE click.
CRT's head separates intact into B's hands. Reveal a clean metal neck socket, no tissue.
B stops, surprised. Screen stays active.

SHOT 4 | 00:16 TO 00:21
Hard cut, wide including B and scooter.
CRT's headless mechanical body runs two steps back to the scooter and grips the handlebar.
Before mounting, it pauses and pats the empty neck socket.
Behind it, B holds the only CRT head at chest height. Screen crackles.

SHOT 5 | 00:21 TO 00:25
Hard cut, medium on B holding the television.
B looks from the screen to the headless body. A watches from the pillar.
CRT's intact short antenna droops slightly at its hinge.
A small embarrassed electronic chirp comes from the television.

SHOT 6 | 00:25 TO 00:30
Hard cut, frontal medium-wide.
The body walks back to B, extending its empty RIGHT palm, asking for its head back.
B looks from the waiting palm to the television.
Hold the final two seconds: outstretched hand, confused thug, embarrassed static.
B keeps holding the head. No reattachment, final strike or black frame.

[CAMERA]
Modern 2D anime: expressive ink, fluid motion, crisp cel shadows, painted Jakarta backgrounds. Burgundy, warm concrete and cool grey.
28-35mm action wides, 50mm reactions. Keep contact and head removal readable.
Hard cuts only at listed boundaries. Consistent screen direction. No orbit or slow motion.

[CONTINUITY]
One CRT head, one matching mechanical body, two thugs, one scooter.
Head separates in shot 3 and stays in B's hands.
Body remains active without its head. All separation is mechanical and bloodless.
A stays by the same pillar after the kick. Scooter remains parked.
Preserve designs and clothing.

[AUDIO]
Footfalls, jacket tension, elbow impact, kick thud, pillar contact, mechanical latch, static, one electronic chirp and distant Jakarta traffic.
Sync impacts. Continuous ambience across cuts.
No dialogue, narration, music, score or tonal pads.

[AVOID]
VHS look, glossy 3D, human CRT face, extra fighters, duplicate head, organic neck, blood, weapons, exploding screen, text, subtitles or logos.

author: @airina_xyz
text:
PROJECT: A GENEROUS NOBLEMAN
FORMAT: 30 seconds, vertical 9:16, seven shots with natural hard cuts.

CREATIVE INTENT:
A dry, character-driven comedy scene from a fictitious 1977 Eastern European medieval fantasy film. The joke emerges from the nobleman's vanity and hypocrisy, not physical slapstick.

CHARACTERS:
LORD BARTHOLOMEW: A corpulent, self-important, middle-aged nobleman with a bulbous red nose, meticulously curled moustache, receding dark hair, extravagant mustard-gold brocade clothing and numerous heavy rings. Utterly convinced of his own virtue. Speaks in a pompous British accent.

THE CLERK: A thin, elderly man with a long face, drooping eyes, grey hair and a modest brown wool robe. Polite, intelligent, understated and quietly incredulous. Speaks in a reserved British accent.

VISUAL LANGUAGE:
Authentic 1977 East European live-action fantasy cinema. Handmade period costumes, practical theatrical makeup, candlelit medieval production design, slightly faded 35mm Eastmancolor, soft optical diffusion and subtle analog film grain.

LOCATION:
One medieval administrative chamber with dark timber walls, a large oak desk, stacked parchment, a brass inkwell and a leaded-glass window. Warm daylight enters from the left. The nobleman stands on the right side of the desk; the clerk sits on the left. Maintain the same positions and 180-degree camera axis throughout.

SHOT 1 — 0:00–0:04
MEDIUM CLOSE-UP: The nobleman suddenly straightens his velvet coat and declares with tremendous pride:
"I have decided to become generous."
He raises his eyebrows as if announcing an historic event.

SHOT 2 — 0:04–0:09
MEDIUM SHOT: The clerk looks up from his parchment, genuinely encouraged.
"Shall I order bread for the villagers, my lord?"
A small, hopeful smile.

SHOT 3 — 0:09–0:13
CLOSE-UP: The nobleman's smile vanishes for half a second.
"No. Summon the royal painter."
He waves his jeweled hand dismissively.

SHOT 4 — 0:13–0:18
CLOSE-UP: The clerk hesitates, quill suspended above the paper.
"To paint the bread?"
His expression is politely bewildered.

SHOT 5 — 0:18–0:23
MEDIUM CLOSE-UP: The nobleman places a hand dramatically over his heart.
"To paint me giving it away!"
He turns slightly into the window light, already imagining his magnificent portrait.

SHOT 6 — 0:23–0:27
TIGHT CLOSE-UP: The clerk slowly lowers the quill.
"And the actual bread?"
He waits, sincerely expecting an answer.

SHOT 7 — 0:27–0:30
CLOSE-UP: The nobleman looks genuinely offended.
"Bread is terribly expensive."
He gives one small, satisfied nod. Hard cut to the clerk's silent, exhausted expression for the final beat.

PERFORMANCE:
Underplayed, precise and psychologically motivated. Small eyebrow movements, brief hesitations, eye contact and realistic conversational pauses. Characters listen and react to each other. Facial identity, wardrobe and props remain stable throughout.

CAMERA:
Mostly stationary 40mm and 65mm compositions with natural lens depth. Very slight handheld camera breathing. No elaborate camera moves. Clean continuity editing.

AUDIO:
Authentic room tone, distant footsteps, rustling parchment, creaking oak furniture and subtle clothing sounds. Dialogue is clearly synchronized and naturally paced. No music, no subtitles, no laugh track.

Shot 14 (24.38 to 26.25 seconds)

Action: The subject laughs softly, shaking their head with genuine ease.

Shot 16 (28.13 to 30 seconds)

Final director notes: The film must inhabit a sun-drenched, carefree 1970s editorial register with modern handheld immediacy. The tactile richness of the crochet weave, yellow floral drape, and olive-and-cream metal must pop in every frame under natural warm light. Shot 16 provides the emotional anchor, leaving the audience with an authentic feeling of golden-hour nostalgia and effortless intimacy.

Audio: Diegetic sound effects: Tie every cue to a visible physical action or a real environmental source. No soundtrack. Use only synchronized diegetic sound effects and ambience supported by the scene.

Mood: Happy; overflowing with spontaneous joy, radiant smiles, and warm exuberant body language.

Continuity: Exact wardrobe, accessories, hair, props (fresh yellow lemons), and warm lighting continuity across all cuts.
Constraints: No gendered terms. Never touch or lean on walls. No music or dialogue. Strictly utilize FPV Tracking movement only.
Vathography: Foreground framing elements create parallax; subject occupies the central depth plane with sharp volumetric separation against soft, warm background village walls.

Shot 1 (0 to 1.5 seconds)
Purpose: Hook viewer with an intimate, radiant smile in motion.
Framing: Close-up, eye-level, 35mm perspective.
Action: The subject strides forward into sunlight, holding a bright lemon in one hand.
Acting: A spontaneous Duchenne smile blooms across the subject's face, gaze locking magnetically onto the lens.
Camera: Dynamic FPV Tracking moves backward rapidly, matching the subject's forward pace.
Constraints: Maintain steady distance; keep face tack-sharp.
Transition: Whip cut on subject's slight turn to incoming wider tracking frame.
Sound effects: Soft step on stone, crisp rustle of linen fabric.

Shot 2 (1.5 to 3 seconds)
Purpose: Reveal environment and full silhouette in motion.
Framing: Medium shot, slight low-angle.
Action: The subject walks along the cobblestones, tossing and catching a lemon with light fingers.
Acting: Buoyant, joyful posture; head tilted slightly back with a delighted grin.
Camera: Low-slung FPV Tracking glides ahead in rapid pursuit, tilting upward subtly.
Constraints: No physical contact with walls; keep movement centered.
Transition: Match-cut on lemon toss to close detail.
Sound effects: Rhythmic shoe taps on cobblestones, soft air displacement from lemon toss.

Shot 3 (3 to 4.5 seconds)
Purpose: Highlight tactile texture of fruit and linen.
Framing: Extreme close-up on hands and mid-torso.
Action: The subject rolls two yellow lemons between nimble fingers against the red dress.
Acting: Relaxed, joyful finger articulation showcasing carefree confidence.
Camera: FPV Tracking sweeps closely across the subject's hands, banking right.
Constraints: Prevent motion blur on the lemons; keep wardrobe texture sharp.
Transition: Fast spatial cut on camera bank into an over-the-shoulder frame.
Sound effects: Subtle citrus skin squeak against fingertips, breeze fluttering ruffled sleeve.

Shot 4 (4.5 to 6 seconds)
Purpose: Capture over-the-shoulder perspective exploring the sunlit path.
Framing: Medium close-up, high over-the-shoulder angle.
Action: The subject strides ahead toward a sun-drenched stone archway.
Acting: Light, brisk pace; shoulders open, joyful head turn catching backlight.
Camera: High FPV Tracking follows closely behind, swooping gently over the subject's shoulder.
Constraints: Maintain fluid motion path without wobbling.
Transition: Direct cut as subject pivots around.
Sound effects: Gentle breeze murmuring through alleyway, light footsteps.

Shot 5 (6 to 7.5 seconds)
Purpose: Intimate frontal face reveal with spontaneous laughter.
Framing: Tight close-up, eye-level.
Action: The subject spins back toward the lens mid-stride.
Acting: Bright eyes crinkling behind sunglasses, lips parting in a brief, genuine laugh.
Camera: FPV Tracking pulls back quickly, banking laterally to cushion the turn.
Constraints: Keep facial features stable and clear despite sudden turn.
Transition: Fast whip cut matching lateral camera movement.
Sound effects: Rapid fabric swoosh, soft breath of laughter.

Shot 6 (7.5 to 9 seconds)
Purpose: Showcase vibrant color contrast and open body posture.
Framing: Medium wide shot, eye-level.
Action: The subject steps into open golden sunlight with arms casually outstretched.
Acting: Expansive, exuberant posture; radiant grin beaming skyward.
Camera: Fast FPV Tracking circles semi-orbitally around the subject.
Constraints: Keep subject well clear of background architecture.
Transition: Cut on circular momentum into medium framing.
Sound effects: Ambient village echo, rustling ruffled linen hem.

Shot 7 (9 to 10.5 seconds)
Purpose: Re-engage close emotional connection with the camera.
Framing: Close-up, slightly high angle.
Action: The subject lifts sunglasses slightly with one hand, flashing direct eye contact.
Acting: Playful, inviting eye contact, warm smile tugging at lip corners.
Camera: FPV Tracking darts closer, stabilizing into a swift forward push.
Constraints: Sunglasses stay balanced; eyes fully visible.
Transition: Cut on sunglasses adjustment to a lower perspective.
Sound effects: Subtle click of wire frames, quiet intake of breath.

Shot 8 (10.5 to 12 seconds)
Purpose: Dynamic dynamic stride along cobblestone alley.
Framing: Medium shot, low-angle.
Action: The subject walks briskly away from camera, swinging arms naturally.
Acting: Lively, bouncy stride full of carefree energy.
Camera: Low FPV Tracking chases closely behind the moving hemline.
Constraints: Stable tracking along uneven stone ground.
Transition: Cut on footstep impact into reverse angle.
Sound effects: Firm, distinct heel taps echoing off rustic stone.

Shot 9 (12 to 13.5 seconds)
Purpose: Catch a candid backward glance over the shoulder.
Framing: Medium close-up, dynamic eye-level.
Action: The subject glances back over one shoulder toward the camera while advancing.
Acting: Playful knowing smirk, eyes sparkling with pure exuberance.
Camera: FPV Tracking overtakes and matches subject speed alongside the shoulder.
Constraints: Clean profile without facial warping.
Transition: Fast whip cut matching camera acceleration.
Sound effects: Whispering summer wind, soft garment friction.

Shot 10 (13.5 to 15 seconds)
Purpose: Accentuate bright Mediterranean colors and tactile fruit.
Framing: Close-up insert tilted toward hands and chest.
Action: The subject brings one lemon near the neckline, rotating it in the sun.
Acting: Graceful, fluid wrist motion, expressing casual appreciation of the day.
Camera: FPV Tracking arcs tightly around the hands, highlighting specular light on fruit.
Constraints: Hands and fruit remain completely in focus.
Transition: Cut on wrist turn to frontal close-up.
Sound effects: Faint friction of linen, soft breeze.

Shot 11 (15 to 16.5 seconds)
Purpose: Capture spontaneous, contained joy in a brief pause.
Framing: Close-up, eye-level.
Action: The subject pauses momentarily mid-alley, turning to face the lens.
Acting: Radiant, authentic beam; eyelids soft and cheeks lifted in pure joy.
Camera: FPV Tracking glides smoothly to an intimate halt just inches away.
Constraints: Preserve natural skin texture and lighting tone.
Transition: Hard cut on subject's outward arm movement.
Sound effects: Gentle sigh of ambient breeze, settling footsteps.

Shot 12 (16.5 to 18 seconds)
Purpose: Convey lively full-body celebration.
Framing: Medium shot, slightly low.
Action: The subject takes a joyful skip-step forward, dress fluttering.
Acting: Carefree, exuberant body language, chest lifted proudly.
Camera: FPV Tracking rushes backward, keeping subject framed dynamically.
Constraints: Subject remains centered during rapid footwork.
Transition: Cut on landing step to high angle.
Sound effects: Quick double tap of shoes, ruffled skirt fluttering.

Shot 13 (18 to 19.5 seconds)
Purpose: Atmospheric, dynamic top-down tracking.
Framing: Medium high-angle.
Action: The subject walks beneath sunlit lemon tree branches hanging over a courtyard.
Acting: Upward glance, open beaming expression.
Camera: FPV Tracking swoops down from above, following subject's path.
Constraints: Keep camera operator reflection invisible in sunglasses.
Transition: Cut on subject's forward head tilt.
Sound effects: Distant rustle of foliage, clear stone footfalls.

Shot 14 (19.5 to 21 seconds)
Purpose: Re-establish close intimate connection.
Framing: Close-up, eye-level.
Action: The subject turns back toward the camera with a bright nod.
Acting: Intimate, welcoming smile; warm ocular engagement.
Camera: FPV Tracking glides rapidly alongside subject's cheek.
Constraints: Facial proportions rock-solid.
Transition: Whip cut on head turn to three-quarter view.
Sound effects: Soft linen rustle, warm exhalation.

Shot 15 (21 to 22.5 seconds)
Purpose: Build toward an energetic finale.
Framing: Medium shot, eye-level.
Action: The subject extends an arm toward the lens in a playful beckoning gesture.
Acting: Magnetic, delighted expression, fingers lightly splayed.
Camera: FPV Tracking matches the gesture, surging smoothly forward.
Constraints: Hand stays in frame without clipping.
Transition: Smooth cut on forward camera thrust to final hero frame.
Sound effects: Swift sleeve flutter, rhythmic footsteps.

Shot 16 (22.5 to 24 seconds)
Purpose: Conclude with a memorable, euphoric portrait in motion.
Framing: Medium close-up, golden hour backlight.
Action: The subject strolls forward, holding both lemons, giving a final radiant smile.
Acting: Deep authentic Duchenne smile, posture relaxed yet beaming with fulfillment.
Camera: FPV Tracking decelerates gently as subject fills the frame, settling gracefully.
Constraints: Maintain facial fidelity; no wall contact; clean, photographic resolution.
Sound effects: Fading footstep on stone, soft summer breeze settling.

Final director notes: Maintain a warm, candid Sicilian lifestyle aesthetic anchored by authentic Italian sun. The red linen dress must pop intensely against the textured ocher stone, and the subject's spontaneous smile must remain the core emotional heartbeat of every cut. Ensure every camera movement feels like an agile, responsive pursuit without losing photographic realism or facial consistency.

Audio: Diegetic sound effects: Tie every cue to a visible physical action or a real environmental source. No soundtrack. Use only synchronized diegetic sound effects and ambience supported by the scene.

author: @kodavid
text: "Handheld UGC try-on clip in a sunlit loft studio. The woman swings the camel wool blazer off her shoulder, slips both arms into the sleeves one at a time, and tugs the lapels straight. Then she does one full slow spin on the spot so the pleated emerald satin skirt flares out and settles back down, and she ends facing the camera with a small smile. The wool creases at the elbows as she bends her arms, and the satin pleats catch the window light as they swing. The camera stays at the same shin-to-head framing the whole time. Realistic fabric physics, natural light, ambient room sound only, no music, no speech, no text on screen."

author: @FlyAIgh
text:
References: images 1, 2 and 3 are the same woman, the woman in ivory: low bun, pearl earrings, an ivory satin slip dress to the floor, a sheer shawl of the same color over her shoulders. Images 4, 5 and 6 are the same woman, the woman in black: long black curls, a black tuxedo suit with burgundy satin lapels. Image 7 is the setting: a private dinner in an art gallery. Both women's faces, features, hair, clothes and accessories always match their own reference images, and the two faces must never blend. Realistic cinematic look, 16:9, an understated luxury dinner, low light, warm low lamps and candlelight, urban short-drama style. 15 seconds in total, four shots.

Shot 1 (0 to 3s, wide): in the gallery from image 7, guests holding glasses talk quietly and move slowly, someone plays the cello in a corner, candles flicker on the tables. The camera descends slowly from ceiling height and pushes forward, starting on the whole room and ending beside the champagne tower. The woman in ivory stands alone by the tower with a glass of champagne.

Shot 2 (3 to 6s, medium, hard cut): the woman in black walks in from the right of frame, grabs her wrist and leans in to say something. The woman in ivory turns to look at her, face to camera, her expression going from restrained to cold. Locked-off camera, both women in frame.

Shot 3 (6 to 11s, side tracking, hard cut): the woman in ivory shakes off her hand and, in the same motion, pushes the champagne tower over, her sheer shawl lifting with the movement. Dozens of glasses fall tier by tier and shatter, champagne splashes everywhere, and the guests around scream and step back. The camera tracks fast from the side in the direction the tower falls, with a little handheld shake.

Shot 4 (11 to 15s, close-up, hard cut): close-up of the woman in ivory, face to camera, a strand of hair falling loose from her bun, pearl earrings swaying slightly, chest rising and falling. Then cut to an over-the-shoulder shot from behind her: the woman in black stands opposite, her black suit splashed with champagne, freezes for a beat, then slowly starts to smile.

No subtitles, no watermark, and apart from the guests, no main characters other than those in the reference images.

author: @kodavid
text: A thick hardcover book lies open on a wooden desk in a cozy lamp-lit study. A whole paper pop-up city unfolds out of the pages: buildings fold up floor by floor, a paper bridge snaps into place over a blue paper river, a tiny paper tram starts rolling along its track, and paper birds flap off the rooftops. The camera dives down from above the desk to street level between the paper buildings while tiny paper people walk and wave. Warm cozy 3D animated style, soft lamp light, rich detail. No text.

title_zh: 体操运动员田径场后空翻
author: @openclipsai
text:
One continuous 10-second shot. Photorealistic, 16:9, a sunny outdoor athletics track in the afternoon. The camera stays still at a side view with her whole body in frame. A female gymnast in a red leotard, hair in a tight bun, stands on a blue landing mat facing frame-right, arms at her sides.

0-3s: She swings both arms back and bends her knees.

3-6s: She jumps straight up and does one full backflip in the air, knees tucked to her chest.

6-8s: She lands on both feet on the mat, knees bending to absorb the impact.

8-10s: She straightens up and raises both arms above her head with a big smile. End state: she stands still on the mat, arms raised.

Audio: birds, a sharp exhale, the whoosh of the flip, a soft thud on the mat, then distant applause. Only natural sound effects, nobody speaks.
